title: An Agent-Based Framework for the Automatic Validation of Mathematical Optimization Models
summary: Recently, using Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate optimization models from natural language descriptions has became increasingly popular. However, a major open question is how to validate that the generated models are correct and satisfy the requirements defined in the natural language description. In this work, we propose a novel agent-based method for automatic validation of optimization models that builds upon and extends methods from software testing to address optimization modeling . This method consists of several agents that initially generate a problem-level testing API, then generate tests utilizing this API, and, lastly, generate mutations specific to the optimization model (a well-known software testing technique assessing the fault detection power of the test suite). In this work, we detail this validation method and show, through both theory and experiments, the high quality of validation provided by this agent ensemble in terms of the well-known software testing measure called mutation coverage.

AI.title_translation: 基于代理的数学优化模型自动验证框架
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新颖的基于代理的方法，用于自动验证由大型语言模型生成的优化模型，通过结合软件测试技术（如变异测试）来确保模型质量。
AI.motivation: 使用大型语言模型从自然语言描述生成优化模型日益流行，但如何验证这些生成模型的正确性并满足自然语言定义的需求是一个主要的开放问题。
AI.method: 该方法是一种新颖的基于代理的优化模型自动验证方法，它建立并扩展了软件测试方法。它由多个代理组成，首先生成问题级别的测试API，然后利用该API生成测试，最后生成针对优化模型的特定变异（一种评估测试套件故障检测能力的软件测试技术）。
AI.result: 通过理论和实验证明，该代理集合在变异覆盖率（一种著名的软件测试度量）方面提供了高质量的验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合软件测试中的变异覆盖率度量，该基于代理的框架能够对由LLM生成的优化模型提供高质量的自动验证。
AI.translation: 最近，使用大型语言模型（LLMs）从自然语言描述生成优化模型越来越流行。然而，一个主要的开放问题是如何验证生成的模型是正确的并满足自然语言描述中定义的要求。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于代理的方法，用于自动验证优化模型，该方法建立并扩展了软件测试方法以解决优化建模问题。该方法由多个代理组成，它们首先生成一个问题级别的测试API，然后利用该API生成测试，最后生成针对优化模型的特定变异（一种评估测试套件故障检测能力的著名软件测试技术）。在这项工作中，我们详细介绍了这种验证方法，并通过理论和实验证明了该代理集合在变异覆盖率（一种著名的软件测试度量）方面提供了高质量的验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于代理的框架，旨在解决大型语言模型（LLMs）生成优化模型后存在的验证难题。该框架借鉴软件测试原理，通过多个代理协作，首先生成问题级别的测试API，随后生成测试用例，并引入针对优化模型的变异测试，以评估测试套件的故障检测能力。研究通过理论和实验证明，该代理集合在提高验证质量方面表现出色，尤其是在变异覆盖率指标上。
AI.keywords: 代理方法, 自动验证, 优化模型, 软件测试, 变异覆盖率
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将软件测试中的代理和变异测试概念引入到数学优化模型的自动验证领域，为LLMs生成模型后的可靠性保障提供了新的思路。其重要性在于解决了LLMs在生成复杂模型时，如何确保模型符合预期规范的关键挑战。该方法有望提高LLM生成优化模型的实际应用价值和信任度。

title: ATAC: Augmentation-Based Test-Time Adversarial Correction for CLIP
summary: Despite its remarkable success in zero-shot image-text matching, CLIP remains highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations on images. As adversarial fine-tuning is prohibitively costly, recent works explore various test-time defense strategies; however, these approaches still exhibit limited robustness. In this work, we revisit this problem and propose a simple yet effective strategy: Augmentation-based Test-time Adversarial Correction (ATAC). Our method operates directly in the embedding space of CLIP, calculating augmentation-induced drift vectors to infer a semantic recovery direction and correcting the embedding based on the angular consistency of these latent drifts. Across a wide range of benchmarks, ATAC consistently achieves remarkably high robustness, surpassing that of previous state-of-the-art methods by nearly 50\% on average, all while requiring minimal computational overhead. Furthermore, ATAC retains state-of-the-art robustness in unconventional and extreme settings and even achieves nontrivial robustness against adaptive attacks. Our results demonstrate that ATAC is an efficient method in a novel paradigm for test-time adversarial defenses in the embedding space of CLIP. Code is available at: https://github.com/kylin0421/ATAC

AI.title_translation: ATAC：基于增强的CLIP测试时对抗性校正
AI.tldr: 尽管CLIP在零样本图像-文本匹配方面取得了成功，但它对对抗性扰动仍然很脆弱。本文提出了一种名为ATAC的简单而有效的测试时防御策略，通过在CLIP嵌入空间中计算增强引起的漂移向量来推断语义恢复方向并进行校正。ATAC在各种基准测试中显著提高了鲁棒性，平均超过现有SOTA方法近50%，且计算开销极小。
AI.motivation: 尽管CLIP在零样本图像-文本匹配方面取得了显著成功，但它仍然极易受到图像对抗性扰动的影响。对抗性微调成本高昂，而现有的测试时防御策略鲁棒性有限。因此，本文旨在提出一种简单有效的测试时防御策略来解决CLIP的对抗性脆弱性问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种名为增强型测试时对抗性校正（ATAC）的方法。该方法直接在CLIP的嵌入空间中操作，通过计算增强引起的漂移向量来推断语义恢复方向，并根据这些潜在漂移的角度一致性来校正嵌入。
AI.result: ATAC在各种基准测试中始终表现出极高的鲁棒性，平均比之前的最先进方法高出近50%，同时计算开销极小。此外，ATAC在非常规和极端设置下仍保持最先进的鲁棒性，甚至对自适应攻击也表现出不俗的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ATAC是一种高效的方法，为CLIP嵌入空间中的测试时对抗性防御提供了一种新颖的范式。
AI.translation: 尽管CLIP在零样本图像-文本匹配方面取得了显著成功，但它仍然极易受到图像对抗性扰动的影响。由于对抗性微调成本过高，最近的工作探索了各种测试时防御策略；然而，这些方法仍然表现出有限的鲁棒性。在这项工作中，我们重新审视了这个问题，并提出了一种简单而有效的策略：基于增强的测试时对抗性校正（ATAC）。我们的方法直接在CLIP的嵌入空间中操作，计算增强引起的漂移向量以推断语义恢复方向，并根据这些潜在漂移的角度一致性来校正嵌入。在各种基准测试中，ATAC始终实现显着高鲁棒性，平均超过以前最先进的方法近50%，同时只需极少的计算开销。此外，ATAC在非常规和极端设置中保持最先进的鲁棒性，甚至对自适应攻击也实现了不俗的鲁棒性。我们的结果表明，ATAC是一种高效的方法，为CLIP嵌入空间中的测试时对抗性防御提供了一种新颖的范式。代码可在：https://github.com/kylin0421/ATAC 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为ATAC（基于增强的测试时对抗性校正）的新方法，旨在解决CLIP模型对图像对抗性扰动的脆弱性问题。ATAC直接在CLIP的嵌入空间中工作，通过计算增强引起的漂移向量来推断语义恢复方向，并根据这些漂移的角度一致性校正嵌入。实验结果表明，ATAC在各种基准测试中显著提高了鲁棒性，平均超越现有SOTA方法近50%，且计算开销极低，即使在极端和自适应攻击下也表现出色。
AI.keywords: CLIP, 对抗性攻击, 测试时防御, 鲁棒性, 嵌入空间
AI.comments: ATAC提出了一种新颖且高效的测试时对抗性防御范式，直接在CLIP的嵌入空间进行校正，避免了昂贵的对抗性微调。其在大幅提升鲁棒性的同时保持低计算开销，是其主要创新点和重要性所在。对自适应攻击的有效性也增加了其实用价值。

title: A Unified Stability Analysis of SAM vs SGD: Role of Data Coherence and Emergence of Simplicity Bias
summary: Understanding the dynamics of optimization in deep learning is increasingly important as models scale. While stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants reliably find solutions that generalize well, the mechanisms driving this generalization remain unclear. Notably, these algorithms often prefer flatter or simpler minima, particularly in overparameterized settings. Prior work has linked flatness to generalization, and methods like Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) explicitly encourage flatness, but a unified theory connecting data structure, optimization dynamics, and the nature of learned solutions is still lacking. In this work, we develop a linear stability framework that analyzes the behavior of SGD, random perturbations, and SAM, particularly in two layer ReLU networks. Central to our analysis is a coherence measure that quantifies how gradient curvature aligns across data points, revealing why certain minima are stable and favored during training.

AI.title_translation: SAM 与 SGD 的统一稳定性分析：数据相干性的作用与简单性偏差的出现
AI.tldr: 本文利用线性稳定性框架分析了 SGD、随机扰动和 SAM 在两层 ReLU 网络中的行为。它引入了一个数据相干性度量来量化梯度曲率在数据点之间的对齐程度，旨在揭示某些最小值为何稳定并受到青睐，从而统一理解优化动态和学习解的性质。
AI.motivation: 理解深度学习中优化的动态性越来越重要，特别是随机梯度下降（SGD）及其变体能够泛化良好但其机制仍不明确。这些算法倾向于平坦或简单的最小值，而连接数据结构、优化动态和学习解性质的统一理论仍缺失。
AI.method: 开发了一个线性稳定性框架，用于分析 SGD、随机扰动和 SAM 在两层 ReLU 网络中的行为。引入了一个相干性度量来量化梯度曲率在数据点之间的对齐程度。
AI.result: 提出的相干性度量揭示了为什么某些最小值是稳定的并在训练过程中受到青睐。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 理解深度学习中优化的动态性随着模型规模的扩大变得越来越重要。虽然随机梯度下降（SGD）及其变体能够可靠地找到泛化良好的解，但驱动这种泛化的机制仍不清楚。值得注意的是，这些算法通常倾向于更平坦或更简单的最小值，特别是在过参数化设置中。先前的研究已将平坦度与泛化联系起来，而像 Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) 这样的方法明确鼓励平坦度，但仍然缺乏一个统一的理论来连接数据结构、优化动态和学习解的性质。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个线性稳定性框架，分析了 SGD、随机扰动和 SAM 的行为，特别是在两层 ReLU 网络中。我们分析的核心是一个相干性度量，它量化了梯度曲率在数据点之间的对齐程度，揭示了为什么某些最小值是稳定的并在训练过程中受到青睐。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个线性稳定性框架，用于分析随机梯度下降（SGD）、随机扰动和 Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) 在两层 ReLU 网络中的行为。该研究旨在通过引入一个新的数据相干性度量来统一理解深度学习优化动态，特别是对平坦/简单最小值的偏好和泛化能力。该度量量化了梯度曲率在数据点之间的对齐程度，从而解释了训练过程中某些最小值的稳定性及受青睐的原因。
AI.keywords: SGD, SAM, 稳定性分析, 数据相干性, 简单性偏差
AI.comments: 该论文提供了一个理论框架（线性稳定性分析）和一个新颖的概念（数据相干性度量），以弥补理解不同优化器（如 SGD 和 SAM）为何能产生可泛化解的空白，特别是在平坦度和简单性偏差的背景下。其对两层 ReLU 网络的关注表明这是一个基础性步骤，未来可能扩展到更复杂的架构。

title: ActDistill: General Action-Guided Self-Derived Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown impressive flexibility and generalization, yet their deployment in robotic manipulation remains limited by heavy computational overhead and inference latency. In this work, we present ActDistill, a general action-guided self-derived distillation framework that transfers the action prediction capability of any existing VLA model to a lightweight counterpart. Unlike previous efficiency strategies that primarily emphasize vision-language correlations, ActDistill leverages action priors to guide knowledge transfer and model compression, achieving action-oriented efficiency for VLA models. Specifically, we employ a well-trained VLA model as the teacher and introduce a graph-structured encapsulation strategy to explicitly model the hierarchical evolution of action prediction. The student model, derived from the graph-encapsulated teacher, is further equipped with a dynamic router that adaptively selects computation paths based on action prediction demands, guided by hierarchical graph-informed supervision to ensure smooth and efficient evolution. During inference, graph-related auxiliary components are removed, allowing the student to execute only dynamically routed layers and predict high-precision actions with minimal computation and latency. Experiments on embodied benchmarks demonstrate that ActDistill achieves comparable or superior performance to full-scale VLA models while reducing computation by over 50% with up to 1.67 times speedup, thereby establishing a general paradigm toward efficient embodied intelligence.

AI.title_translation: ActDistill：通用动作引导的自衍生蒸馏，用于高效视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.tldr: ActDistill是一种动作引导的自蒸馏框架，能将大型VLA模型的动作预测能力转移到轻量级模型，显著提高效率和速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽然展现出色的灵活性和泛化能力，但其高计算开销和推理延迟限制了在机器人操作中的实际部署。
AI.method: ActDistill采用一个训练好的VLA模型作为教师，通过图结构封装策略明确建模动作预测的层次演变。学生模型从中衍生，并配备一个动态路由器，根据动作预测需求自适应选择计算路径，由分层图信息监督指导。推理时，辅助组件被移除，学生模型仅执行动态路由层，以最小计算量和延迟预测高精度动作。
AI.result: 在具身基准测试中，ActDistill实现了与全尺寸VLA模型相当或更优的性能，同时将计算量减少了50%以上，速度提高了1.67倍。
AI.conclusion: ActDistill通过动作引导的自衍生蒸馏为高效具身智能建立了一个通用范式，显著提升了VLA模型的效率和部署潜力。
AI.translation: 近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型展现出令人印象深刻的灵活性和泛化能力，然而，其在机器人操作中的部署仍受限于庞大的计算开销和推理延迟。在这项工作中，我们提出了ActDistill，一个通用的动作引导自衍生蒸馏框架，它能将任何现有VLA模型的动作预测能力转移到轻量级对应模型上。与以往主要强调视觉-语言相关性的效率策略不同，ActDistill利用动作先验来指导知识迁移和模型压缩，从而为VLA模型实现面向动作的效率。具体而言，我们采用一个训练有素的VLA模型作为教师模型，并引入图结构封装策略来明确建模动作预测的层次演变。学生模型从图封装的教师模型中衍生，并进一步配备了一个动态路由器，该路由器根据动作预测需求自适应地选择计算路径，并由分层图信息监督指导，以确保平稳高效的演变。在推理过程中，图相关的辅助组件被移除，使得学生模型只执行动态路由层，以最小的计算量和延迟预测高精度动作。在具身基准测试上的实验表明，ActDistill实现了与全尺寸VLA模型相当或更优的性能，同时将计算量减少了50%以上，速度提高了1.67倍，从而为高效具身智能建立了一个通用范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ActDistill，一个动作引导的自衍生蒸馏框架，旨在解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中面临的计算开销和推理延迟问题。该框架通过利用动作先验指导知识迁移，将大型VLA教师模型的动作预测能力高效地转移到轻量级学生模型。学生模型结合图结构封装和动态路由器，能够在推理时显著减少计算量并提高速度，同时保持或超越原有性能，为实现高效具身智能提供了新的通用范式。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 模型蒸馏, 机器人操作, 计算效率, 动态路由
AI.comments: ActDistill的创新之处在于其“动作引导”和“自衍生蒸馏”范式，特别是利用动作先验和图结构封装来优化VLA模型的效率，而非仅仅关注视觉-语言相关性。动态路由器的引入进一步提升了模型的适应性和推理效率，这对于将强大的VLA模型实际部署到资源受限的机器人平台具有重要意义。

title: SkillSight: Efficient First-Person Skill Assessment with Gaze
summary: Egocentric perception on smart glasses could transform how we learn new skills in the physical world, but automatic skill assessment remains a fundamental technical challenge. We introduce SkillSight for power-efficient skill assessment from first-person data. Central to our approach is the hypothesis that skill level is evident not only in how a person performs an activity (video), but also in how they direct their attention when doing so (gaze). Our two-stage framework first learns to jointly model gaze and egocentric video when predicting skill level, then distills a gaze-only student model. At inference, the student model requires only gaze input, drastically reducing power consumption by eliminating continuous video processing. Experiments on three datasets spanning cooking, music, and sports establish, for the first time, the valuable role of gaze in skill understanding across diverse real-world settings. Our SkillSight teacher model achieves state-of-the-art performance, while our gaze-only student variant maintains high accuracy using 73x less power than competing methods. These results pave the way for in-the-wild AI-supported skill learning.

AI.title_translation: SkillSight：利用注视点进行高效的第一人称技能评估
AI.tldr: 通过利用注视点数据进行技能评估并结合知识蒸馏，SkillSight实现了在大幅降低功耗的同时保持高精度评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的自我中心技能评估方法依赖持续的视频处理，功耗过高，无法满足智能眼镜等设备在真实场景中的应用需求。
AI.method: 提出了一个两阶段框架：首先训练一个联合建模注视点与自我中心视频的教师模型，随后通过知识蒸馏训练一个仅依赖注视点输入的学生模型。
AI.result: SkillSight教师模型达到了领域领先水平；学生模型在仅使用注视点输入的情况下，功耗降低了73倍，同时保持了高准确率。
AI.conclusion: SkillSight证明了注视点数据在技能评估中的核心价值，通过知识蒸馏实现了高精度与超低功耗的平衡，为实际应用中的AI辅助技能学习提供了高效解决方案。
AI.translation: 智能眼镜上的自我中心感知有望改变我们在物理世界学习新技能的方式，但自动技能评估仍然是一个基础性的技术挑战。我们引入了SkillSight，用于从第一人称数据中进行高能效的技能评估。我们方法的核心假设是：技能水平不仅体现在一个人如何执行活动（视频），还体现在他们在执行活动时如何引导注意力（注视点）。我们的两阶段框架首先学习在预测技能水平时联合建模注视点和自我中心视频，然后蒸馏出一个仅含注视点的学生模型。在推理时，学生模型仅需要注视点输入，通过消除连续的视频处理，大幅降低了功耗。在涵盖烹饪、音乐和体育的三个数据集上的实验首次确立了注视点在不同现实世界环境中对技能理解的宝贵作用。我们的SkillSight教师模型实现了最先进的性能，而我们的纯注视点学生模型变体在功耗比竞争方法低73倍的情况下保持了高准确率。这些结果为在野外进行AI辅助技能学习铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SkillSight框架，通过结合视频和注视点信息进行技能评估。为了解决高功耗问题，该方法利用知识蒸馏技术训练了一个仅需注视点输入的学生模型，在保持高评估精度的同时，显著降低了计算成本。
AI.keywords: 自我中心视觉, 技能评估, 注视点, 知识蒸馏, 智能眼镜
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将注视点（gaze）信息引入技能评估领域，并提出了基于知识蒸馏的轻量化方案，极大地降低了智能眼镜等端侧设备的功耗，为可穿戴AI应用提供了切实可行的技术路径。其局限性在于对高精度注视点追踪硬件的依赖。

title: General Multi-User Distributed Computing: A Learning-Theoretic RKHS Framework for Generic Nonlinear Target Functions with Topology-Aware Risk Analysis
summary: This paper studies multi-user distributed computation over shared real-valued subfunctions under computation and communication constraints. We consider a \emph{General Multi-User Distributed Computing (GMUDC)} model in which different users request heterogeneous target functions represented in the reproducing-kernel Hilbert space of a shift-invariant kernel, thereby covering generic nonlinear target mappings beyond linearly separable tasks. Unlike tessellated distributed computing frameworks that rely on disjoint-support topologies in their native setting, the GMUDC model allows arbitrary task-assignment and connectivity topologies subject to per-server computation and communication budgets~$Γ$ and~$Δ$. We analyze two complementary regimes. In the \emph{quenched} regime, the assignment and communication topology are fixed, and we derive upper and lower bounds on the resulting reconstruction risk that separate a spectral approximation term from a topology-dependent coverage term. In the \emph{annealed} regime, the assignment and links are drawn uniformly at random from a prescribed ensemble, and we characterize the corresponding average-risk scaling together with a topology-dependent coverage threshold. These results provide a topology-aware characterization of the computation--communication--accuracy trade-off for approximate multi-user distributed computation. They identify fundamental limits, up to constants and logarithmic factors, under the model assumptions adopted in the paper. In the shared linear/isotropic comparison regime, the framework also recovers the relevant tessellated distributed computing benchmark, while the broader GMUDC formulation applies to generic nonlinear target functions in kernel RKHSs and accommodates a wider range of task-assignment and communication topologies than disjoint-support constructions alone.

AI.title_translation: 通用多用户分布式计算：一种针对通用非线性目标函数及拓扑感知风险分析的学习理论RKHS框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在RKHS框架下处理非线性目标函数的分布式计算模型，分析了计算与通信约束下的重构风险，并实现了对任意任务分配拓扑的理论支持。
AI.motivation: 现有的分布式计算模型大多局限于线性可分任务或特定的不相交支撑集拓扑，无法有效处理更通用的非线性目标函数以及灵活的计算任务分配需求。
AI.method: 采用再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）框架建模非线性目标函数，并在“淬火”（固定拓扑）和“退火”（随机拓扑）两种机制下，通过谱近似和拓扑覆盖项分析重构风险上限与下限。
AI.result: 推导出了在计算与通信预算约束下，通用多用户分布式计算的重构风险上限与下限；刻画了平均风险缩放比例及拓扑相关的覆盖阈值；证明了该框架在特定条件下可退化为传统分布式计算基准。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了通用多用户分布式计算的理论基础，证明了计算、通信与重构风险之间的基本权衡关系，并为处理非线性任务提供了灵活的拓扑通用框架。
AI.translation: 本文研究了在计算和通信约束下，针对共享实值子函数的多用户分布式计算。我们考虑了一种“通用多用户分布式计算（GMUDC）”模型，其中不同用户请求由平移不变核的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）表示的异构目标函数，从而涵盖了超越线性可分任务的通用非线性目标映射。与依赖于原生设置中不相交支撑拓扑的镶嵌式分布式计算框架不同，GMUDC模型允许在每台服务器计算和通信预算Γ和Δ的约束下，进行任意的任务分配和连接拓扑。我们分析了两种互补的机制。在“淬火”机制中，分配和通信拓扑是固定的，我们推导了重构风险的上限和下限，将谱近似项与拓扑相关的覆盖项分离开来。在“退火”机制中，分配和链路是从预定集合中均匀随机抽取的，我们描述了相应的平均风险缩放以及拓扑相关的覆盖阈值。这些结果为近似多用户分布式计算的计算-通信-精度权衡提供了拓扑感知的刻画，并识别了在本文假设模型下的基本极限（精确到常数和对数因子）。在共享线性/各向同性比较机制中，该框架还恢复了相关的镶嵌式分布式计算基准，而更广泛的GMUDC公式适用于核RKHS中的通用非线性目标函数，并能容纳比仅依赖不相交支撑结构更广泛的任务分配和通信拓扑。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通用多用户分布式计算（GMUDC）模型，利用RKHS框架处理非线性目标函数，并摆脱了传统模型对特定拓扑结构的限制。文章通过风险分析深入探讨了计算、通信与精度之间的基本权衡。
AI.keywords: 多用户分布式计算, 再生核希尔伯特空间, 非线性目标函数, 拓扑感知风险分析, 计算通信权衡
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将分布式计算问题置于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）框架下，成功处理了非线性目标函数，并突破了传统分布式计算对“不相交支撑集”拓扑结构的依赖。其在“淬火”和“退火”两种机制下的风险分析，为计算、通信与精度之间的权衡提供了深刻的理论洞察。

title: SPHINX: A Synthetic Environment for Visual Perception and Reasoning
summary: We present Sphinx, a synthetic environment for visual perception and reasoning that targets core cognitive primitives. Sphinx procedurally generates puzzles using motifs, tiles, charts, icons, and geometric primitives, each paired with verifiable ground-truth solutions, enabling both precise evaluation and large-scale dataset construction. The benchmark covers 25 task types spanning symmetry detection, geometric transformations, spatial reasoning, chart interpretation, and sequence prediction. Evaluating recent large vision-language models (LVLMs) shows that even state-of-the-art GPT-5 attains only 51.1% accuracy, well below human performance. Finally, we demonstrate that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves model accuracy on these tasks and yields gains on external visual reasoning benchmarks, highlighting its promise for advancing multimodal reasoning.

AI.title_translation: SPHINX：一个用于视觉感知与推理的合成环境
AI.tldr: Sphinx是一个用于评估和提升多模态模型视觉推理能力的合成环境，研究发现大模型在该环境下的基础认知能力仍有待提高，而RLVR是有效的优化手段。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉推理基准难以进行精确评估或规模化扩展，且当前大模型在基础认知任务上表现尚不成熟，需要一个可验证、可生成的环境来推动视觉感知与推理的研究。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于程序化生成的合成环境Sphinx，涵盖25种视觉任务，并利用强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）来优化模型性能。
AI.result: 测试显示当前顶尖模型（如GPT-5）在Sphinx上的准确率仅为51.1%，显著低于人类水平；而应用RLVR方法后，模型在Sphinx及外部基准测试上的准确率均得到实质性提升。
AI.conclusion: Sphinx为视觉感知和推理提供了一个可验证的基准测试平台，研究表明通过RLVR方法可以显著提升模型在复杂视觉任务上的表现。
AI.translation: 我们提出了Sphinx，这是一个针对核心认知原语的视觉感知与推理合成环境。Sphinx通过主题、平铺、图表、图标和几何原语程序化生成拼图，每个拼图都配有可验证的真值解，从而实现精确评估和大规模数据集构建。该基准测试涵盖了25种任务类型，包括对称性检测、几何变换、空间推理、图表解释和序列预测。对近期大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的评估显示，即使是最先进的GPT-5，准确率也仅为51.1%，远低于人类水平。最后，我们证明了带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提高了模型在这些任务上的准确率，并在外部视觉推理基准测试中取得了性能提升，突显了其在推动多模态推理方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为Sphinx的合成环境，通过程序化生成包含多种视觉元素和几何原语的拼图任务，旨在对视觉感知与推理能力进行精确评估。该环境支持自动生成带有真值的训练数据，研究发现当前大模型在此类任务中表现平平，但通过RLVR训练可有效提升其多模态推理性能。
AI.keywords: 合成环境, 视觉推理, 多模态大模型, 强化学习, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入合成环境填补了视觉推理评估的空白，揭示了当前顶尖多模态模型在基础认知任务上的不足，并验证了RLVR在提升多模态推理能力方面的有效性，具有重要的基准测试价值。

title: Semantic Superiority vs. Forensic Efficiency: A Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning and Psycholinguistics for Business Email Compromise Detection
comments: 8 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to the 7th IEEE Silicon Valley Cybersecurity Conference (SVCC 2026), San Jose, CA, USA, June 10-12, 2026
summary: Business Email Compromise (BEC) is a high-impact social engineering threat with extreme operational asymmetry: false negatives can trigger large financial losses, while false positives primarily incur investigation and delay costs. This paper compares two BEC detection paradigms under a cost-sensitive decision framework: (i) a semantic transformer approach (DistilBERT) for contextual language understanding, and (ii) a forensic psycholinguistic approach (CatBoost) using engineered linguistic and structural cues. We evaluate both on a hybrid dataset (N = 7,990) combining legitimate corporate email and AI-synthesised adversarial fraud generated across 30 BEC taxonomies, including character-level Unicode obfuscations. We add classical baselines (TF-IDF+LogReg and character n-gram+Linear SVM), an ablation study for the Smiling Assassin Score, and a homoglyph-map sensitivity analysis. DistilBERT achieves AUC = 1.0000 and F1 = 0.9981 at 7.403 ms per email on GPU; CatBoost achieves AUC = 0.9860 and F1 = 0.9382 at 0.855 ms on CPU. A three-way cost-sensitive decision policy (auto-allow, auto-block, manual review) optimises expected financial loss under a 1:5,167 false-negative-to-false-positive cost ratio.

AI.title_translation: 语义优势与法医效率：深度学习与心理语言学在商务电子邮件欺诈检测中的对比分析
AI.tldr: 本文通过对比DistilBERT与CatBoost，探讨了在商务邮件欺诈检测中如何平衡高准确率的语义分析与高效率的心理语言学特征工程，并提出了成本最优的决策策略。
AI.motivation: 商务电子邮件欺诈（BEC）具有极高的财务风险且存在严重的运营不对称性（漏报代价远高于误报），需要一种能平衡检测准确性与经济成本的优化方案。
AI.method: 对比分析了基于DistilBERT的语义Transformer方法与基于CatBoost的法医心理语言学特征工程方法。构建了包含真实邮件与AI生成欺诈邮件的混合数据集（N=7,990），并引入了包含自动允许、自动拦截、人工审核的三方成本敏感决策策略。
AI.result: DistilBERT在准确性上领先（AUC=1.0000，F1=0.9981），但推理速度较慢（7.403ms/邮件）；CatBoost准确性略低（AUC=0.9860，F1=0.9382），但推理速度极快（0.855ms/邮件，CPU运行）。
AI.conclusion: 虽然DistilBERT在准确性上表现卓越，但CatBoost在推理速度和资源消耗上具备明显优势。在实际业务中，应根据具体的误报/漏报成本比率选择合适的检测范式。
AI.translation: 商务电子邮件欺诈（BEC）是一种高影响力的社会工程威胁，具有极端的运营不对称性：漏报可能引发巨额经济损失，而误报主要产生调查和延迟成本。本文在成本敏感的决策框架下对比了两种BEC检测范式：(i) 用于上下文语言理解的语义Transformer方法（DistilBERT），以及 (ii) 使用工程语言学和结构线索的法医心理语言学方法（CatBoost）。我们在一个包含真实企业邮件和跨30种BEC分类（包括字符级Unicode混淆）生成的AI合成欺诈邮件的混合数据集（N = 7,990）上对两者进行了评估。我们增加了经典基线（TF-IDF+LogReg和字符n-gram+线性SVM）、Smiling Assassin Score的消融研究以及同形异义字映射敏感性分析。DistilBERT在GPU上以每封邮件7.403毫秒的速度实现了AUC=1.0000和F1=0.9981；CatBoost在CPU上以0.855毫秒的速度实现了AUC=0.9860和F1=0.9382。一种三方成本敏感决策策略（自动允许、自动拦截、人工审查）在1:5,167的漏报与误报成本比下优化了预期财务损失。
AI.summary: 本文对比了DistilBERT与CatBoost在BEC检测中的表现。研究发现，深度学习模型在语义理解上具有绝对优势，而基于心理语言学的特征工程方法在计算效率上更胜一筹。通过成本敏感的决策框架，作者证明了检测范式的选择应基于漏报与误报的经济权重进行优化。
AI.keywords: 商务电子邮件欺诈 (BEC), 深度学习, 心理语言学, 成本敏感决策, 语义分析
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地对比了深度学习（语义）与传统机器学习（法医心理语言学）在BEC检测中的效能。其创新之处在于引入了成本敏感的决策框架，不仅关注准确率，还权衡了计算开销与误报/漏报的经济代价，这对于企业实际部署具有极高的参考价值。

title: Can Protective Watermarking Safeguard the Copyright of 3D Gaussian Splatting?
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful representation for 3D scenes, widely adopted due to its exceptional efficiency and high-fidelity visual quality. Given the significant value of 3DGS assets, recent works have introduced specialized watermarking schemes to ensure copyright protection and ownership verification. However, can existing 3D Gaussian watermarking approaches genuinely guarantee robust protection of the 3D assets? In this paper, for the first time, we systematically explore and validate possible vulnerabilities of 3DGS watermarking frameworks. We demonstrate that conventional watermark removal techniques designed for 2D images do not effectively generalize to the 3DGS scenario due to the specialized rendering pipeline and unique attributes of each gaussian primitives. Motivated by this insight, we propose GSPure, the first watermark purification framework specifically for 3DGS watermarking representations. By analyzing view-dependent rendering contributions and exploiting geometrically accurate feature clustering, GSPure precisely isolates and effectively removes watermark-related Gaussian primitives while preserving scene integrity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our GSPure achieves the best watermark purification performance, reducing watermark PSNR by up to 16.34dB while minimizing degradation to original scene fidelity with less than 1dB PSNR loss. Moreover, it consistently outperforms existing methods in both effectiveness and generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/insightlab-CG-3DV/GSPure.

AI.title_translation: 保护性水印能捍卫3D高斯溅射的版权吗？
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了3DGS水印技术的脆弱性，并提出了GSPure框架，该框架能高效移除3DGS中的水印，同时保持场景质量，挑战了现有版权保护方案的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有针对3DGS的水印方案缺乏系统性的鲁棒性验证，作者旨在探讨这些水印是否能真正保护3D资产，并揭示其存在的安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出了GSPure净化框架，通过分析视点依赖的渲染贡献度以及利用几何精确的特征聚类，精确识别并移除与水印相关的Gaussian基元，同时最大限度地保持场景完整性。
AI.result: GSPure在净化性能上表现卓越，能将水印PSNR降低高达16.34dB，同时将场景原始保真度损失控制在1dB PSNR以内，优于现有的各类通用方法。
AI.conclusion: GSPure证明了现有3DGS水印方案在面对专门针对性的净化攻击时是脆弱的，强调了在开发3D资产保护技术时需要考虑更高级的防御机制。
AI.translation: 3D高斯溅射（3DGS）已成为3D场景的一种强大表示形式，因其卓越的效率和高保真的视觉质量而被广泛采用。鉴于3DGS资产的巨大价值，近期的研究引入了专门的水印方案以确保版权保护和所有权验证。然而，现有的3D高斯水印方法真的能保证对3D资产的稳健保护吗？在本文中，我们首次系统地探索并验证了3DGS水印框架可能存在的脆弱性。我们证明，由于专门的渲染流水线和每个高斯基元的独特性质，为2D图像设计的传统水印去除技术无法有效地推广到3DGS场景中。受此启发，我们提出了GSPure，这是第一个专门针对3DGS水印表示的净化框架。通过分析视点依赖的渲染贡献并利用几何精确的特征聚类，GSPure能够精确隔离并有效地去除与水印相关的高斯基元，同时保持场景的完整性。大量实验表明，我们的GSPure实现了最佳的水印净化性能，在将水印PSNR降低高达16.34dB的同时，将原始场景保真度的损失控制在1dB PSNR以内。此外，它在有效性和泛化性方面均优于现有方法。代码已在 https://github.com/insightlab-CG-3DV/GSPure 开源。
AI.summary: 本文针对3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的版权保护问题，首次系统评估了现有水印方案的鲁棒性，发现传统2D水印移除方法在3DGS中失效。为此，作者开发了GSPure框架，通过几何特征聚类和视点依赖分析，能够高效、精确地移除3DGS水印，同时保持场景的高保真度。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯溅射, 版权保护, 水印净化, 几何特征聚类, 资产安全
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统性地揭示了3DGS水印框架的脆弱性，并提出了专门的净化框架GSPure。其创新之处在于利用了3DGS的独特渲染特性（视点依赖性和几何特征聚类）来精确去除水印，而非简单套用2D图像的处理方法，这为3D资产的版权保护研究敲响了警钟。

title: Bringing Your Portrait to 3D Presence
summary: We present a unified framework for reconstructing animatable 3D human avatars from a single portrait across head, half-body, and full-body inputs. Our method tackles three bottlenecks: pose- and framing-sensitive feature representations, limited scalable data, and unreliable proxy-mesh estimation. We introduce a Dual-UV representation that maps image features to a canonical UV space via Core-UV and Shell-UV branches, eliminating pose- and framing-induced token shifts. We also build a factorized synthetic data manifold combining 2D generative diversity with geometry-consistent 3D renderings, supported by a training scheme that improves realism and identity consistency. A robust proxy-mesh tracker maintains stability under partial visibility. Together, these components enable strong in-the-wild generalization. Trained only on half-body synthetic data, our model achieves state-of-the-art head and upper-body reconstruction and competitive full-body results. Extensive experiments and analyses further validate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.title_translation: 让你的肖像呈现3D形态
AI.tldr: 通过双UV表示和合成数据训练，实现从单张肖像到高质量、可动画化3D人体化身的通用重建。
AI.motivation: 解决单目肖像重建中存在的姿态与构图敏感性、数据规模受限以及代理网格估计不可靠等核心瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 引入Dual-UV（Core-UV和Shell-UV）表示法消除姿态和构图偏移；构建因子化合成数据流形以提升数据多样性与几何一致性；采用鲁棒的代理网格追踪器处理部分遮挡。
AI.result: 实现了最先进的头部和上半身重建效果，并在全身重建上表现出极强的竞争力，具有良好的跨场景泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个鲁棒的统一框架，仅通过半身合成数据训练即可实现高质量、跨尺度的3D人体化身重建，在野外场景中表现出优秀的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个统一的框架，用于从单张肖像输入（包括头部、半身和全身）重建可动画化的3D人体化身。我们的方法解决了三个瓶颈：对姿态和构图敏感的特征表示、有限的可扩展数据以及不可靠的代理网格估计。我们引入了一种双UV表示法，通过Core-UV和Shell-UV分支将图像特征映射到规范的UV空间，消除了姿态和构图引起的标记偏移。我们还构建了一个因子化的合成数据流形，结合了2D生成的多样性和几何一致的3D渲染，并辅以提高真实感和身份一致性的训练方案。一个鲁棒的代理网格追踪器在部分可见性下保持了稳定性。这些组件共同实现了强大的野外泛化能力。我们的模型仅在半身合成数据上训练，即实现了最先进的头部和上半身重建，并在全身重建上取得了竞争性的结果。广泛的实验和分析进一步验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个统一的3D人体化身重建框架，通过创新的双UV表示法和合成数据训练策略，克服了单目肖像输入中姿态和构图的限制，实现了从头部到全身的高质量三维重建。
AI.keywords: 3D化身重建, 双UV表示, 生成式合成数据, 鲁棒追踪, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 该论文通过双UV表示法和因子化合成数据策略，成功解决了单目肖像重建中常见的姿态敏感性和数据稀缺问题，实现了从头部到全身的通用化重建，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Action-guided generation of 3D functionality segmentation data
comments: Accepted at CVPR 2026 GenRecon3D workshop. 17 pages, 8 figures, 1 table
summary: 3D functionality segmentation aims to identify the interactive element in a 3D scene required to perform an action described in free-form language (e.g., the handle to ``Open the second drawer of the cabinet near the bed''). Progress has been constrained by the scarcity of annotated real-world data, as collecting and labeling fine-grained 3D masks is prohibitively expensive. To address this limitation, we introduce SynthFun3D, the first method for generating 3D functionality segmentation data directly from action descriptions. Given an action description, SynthFun3D constructs a plausible 3D scene by retrieving objects with part-level annotations from a large-scale asset repository and arranging them under spatial and semantic constraints. SynthFun3D renders multi-view images and automatically identifies the target functional element, producing precise ground-truth masks without manual annotation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the generated data by training a VLM-based 3D functionality segmentation model. Augmenting real-world data with our synthetic data consistently improves performance, with gains of +2.2 mAP, +6.3 mAR, and +5.7 mIoU over real-only training. This shows that action-guided synthetic data generation provides a scalable and effective complement to manual annotation for 3D functionality understanding. Project page: tev-fbk.github.io/synthfun3d.
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 GenRecon3D workshop. 17 pages, 8 figures, 1 table

AI.title_translation: 基于动作引导的3D功能分割数据生成
AI.tldr: SynthFun3D通过动作描述自动生成带标注的3D功能分割数据，有效解决了数据稀缺问题并显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 3D功能分割领域因缺乏大规模、精细标注的真实世界数据而进展缓慢，手动标注成本极高。
AI.method: 提出SynthFun3D方法：根据动作描述，从资产库中检索带部件注释的对象，通过空间与语义约束构建3D场景，并利用多视图渲染自动生成精确的地面实况掩码。
AI.result: 使用生成的合成数据训练VLM模型，在真实数据基础上性能显著提升（mAP +2.2，mAR +6.3，mIoU +5.7）。
AI.conclusion: SynthFun3D证明了利用动作描述引导生成合成数据是解决3D功能分割标注稀缺问题的有效且可扩展的方案。
AI.translation: 3D功能分割旨在识别执行自由形式语言描述动作（例如“打开床边柜子的第二个抽屉”）所需的3D场景中的交互元素。由于收集和标记细粒度的3D掩码极其昂贵，该领域的发展一直受到标注真实世界数据稀缺的限制。为了解决这一局限，我们引入了SynthFun3D，这是首个直接根据动作描述生成3D功能分割数据的方法。给定一个动作描述，SynthFun3D通过从大规模资产库中检索具有部件级注释的对象，并在空间和语义约束下排列它们，构建一个合理的3D场景。SynthFun3D渲染多视图图像并自动识别目标功能元素，无需人工标注即可产生精确的地面实况掩码。我们通过训练基于VLM的3D功能分割模型证明了生成数据的有效性。用我们的合成数据增强真实世界数据一致地提高了性能，比仅使用真实数据训练在mAP上提高了+2.2，mAR上提高了+6.3，mIoU上提高了+5.7。这表明动作引导的合成数据生成为3D功能理解提供了一种可扩展且有效的补充，以替代人工标注。项目页面：tev-fbk.github.io/synthfun3d。
AI.summary: SynthFun3D是一种通过动作描述自动生成3D功能分割训练数据的方法。它通过检索对象并按约束构建场景，自动生成高质量的掩码，无需人工标注。实验证明该方法生成的合成数据能有效提升3D模型在功能分割任务上的表现。
AI.keywords: 3D功能分割, 动作引导生成, 合成数据, 语义约束, 视觉语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的合成数据生成范式，解决了3D功能分割领域长期面临的数据稀缺瓶颈。通过自动生成带注释的3D场景，该方法不仅降低了标注成本，还显著提升了现有模型的性能，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Ten-Four: An Open-Source Fused Dot Product Unit for Mixed-Precision GPGPU Tensor Cores
summary: Efficient mixed-precision matrix multiply accumulate (MMA) operations are critical for accelerating deep learning workloads on GPGPUs. However, existing open-source dot product implementations for Tensor Cores rely on discrete arithmetic units, leading to high latency, accumulated rounding errors, and poor resource utilization. To address these challenges, we propose Ten-Four, a scalable mixed-precision fused dot product unit that integrates both the floating-point and integer arithmetic pipelines within a single fused architecture, implemented as part of the open-source RISC-V-based Vortex GPGPU's Tensor Core Unit extension. Our design supports low-precision multiplication in FP16/BF16/FP8/BF8/INT8/INT4 formats and higher-precision accumulation in FP32/INT32, with native support for Microscaling (MX) and sparse lane clock-gating for dynamic power reduction, while matching NVIDIA Tensor Core's numerical accuracy. Ten-Four achieves 4-cycle operation latency at 262.325 MHz Fmax, delivering 134.308 GFLOPS peak throughput per Tensor Core on the AMD Xilinx Alveo U55C FPGA, demonstrating ~3.1x performance improvement over an equivalent Berkeley HardFloat-based implementation at less than 60% the area cost.

AI.title_translation: Ten-Four：用于混合精度GPGPU Tensor Core的开源融合点积单元
AI.tldr: Ten-Four是一种新型开源融合点积单元，通过融合算术流水线，在混合精度计算中实现了比现有方案高3.1倍的性能，且硬件资源占用更低。
AI.motivation: 现有开源Tensor Core的离散算术单元设计存在高延迟、累积舍入误差以及资源利用率低的问题，无法满足深度学习工作负载的高效计算需求。
AI.method: 提出Ten-Four架构，将浮点和整数算术流水线集成到单一融合单元中；支持FP16/BF16/FP8/BF8/INT8/INT4乘法与FP32/INT32累加；引入Microscaling（MX）支持及稀疏通道时钟门控技术。
AI.result: 在AMD Xilinx Alveo U55C FPGA上实现4周期延迟，峰值吞吐量达134.308 GFLOPS；性能相比Berkeley HardFloat实现提升约3.1倍，面积开销降低至60%以下。
AI.conclusion: Ten-Four通过融合架构设计，在保持高数值精度的同时，显著提升了混合精度矩阵乘加运算的吞吐量，并降低了硬件资源开销，是开源GPGPU加速器领域的重要进展。
AI.translation: 高效的混合精度矩阵乘加（MMA）运算对于加速GPGPU上的深度学习工作负载至关重要。然而，现有的Tensor Core开源点积实现依赖于离散的算术单元，导致高延迟、累积舍入误差和资源利用率低下。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Ten-Four，这是一种可扩展的混合精度融合点积单元，它将浮点和整数算术流水线集成在单一融合架构中，并作为开源基于RISC-V的Vortex GPGPU Tensor Core单元扩展的一部分实现。我们的设计支持FP16/BF16/FP8/BF8/INT8/INT4格式的低精度乘法和FP32/INT32的高精度累加，原生支持Microscaling（MX）和用于动态功率降低的稀疏通道时钟门控，同时匹配了NVIDIA Tensor Core的数值精度。Ten-Four在AMD Xilinx Alveo U55C FPGA上实现了4周期的操作延迟和262.325 MHz的最大频率，每个Tensor Core提供134.308 GFLOPS的峰值吞吐量，相比基于Berkeley HardFloat的等效实现，性能提升了约3.1倍，且面积成本不到60%。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Ten-Four，一种用于RISC-V Vortex GPGPU的开源混合精度融合点积单元。该设计通过融合浮点与整数流水线，支持多种低精度运算及Microscaling，在显著提升计算吞吐量和降低资源开销的同时，保证了与NVIDIA Tensor Core相当的精度。
AI.keywords: 混合精度, Tensor Core, GPGPU, 融合点积单元, RISC-V
AI.comments: 该研究通过融合浮点与整数算术流水线，有效地解决了开源GPGPU Tensor Core在混合精度计算中存在的延迟高、舍入误差大和资源利用率低的问题。其显著优势在于提供了对多种低精度格式的原生支持，并实现了性能与硬件面积的极佳平衡，对开源高性能计算领域具有重要意义。

title: Low-Bitrate Video Compression through Semantic-Conditioned Diffusion
summary: Traditional video codecs optimized for pixel fidelity collapse at ultra-low bitrates and produce severe artifacts. This failure arises from a fundamental misalignment between pixel accuracy and human perception. We propose a semantic video compression framework named DiSCo that transmits only the most meaningful information while relying on generative priors for detail synthesis. The source video is decomposed into three compact modalities: a textual description, a spatiotemporally degraded video, and optional sketches or poses that respectively capture semantic, appearance, and motion cues. A conditional video diffusion model then reconstructs high-quality, temporally coherent videos from these compact representations. Temporal forward filling, token interleaving, and modality-specific codecs are proposed to improve multimodal generation and modality compactness. Experiments show that our method outperforms baseline semantic and traditional codecs by 2-10X on perceptual metrics at low bitrates.

AI.title_translation: 基于语义条件扩散的低比特率视频压缩
AI.tldr: DiSCo通过将视频分解为语义、外观和运动三部分并利用扩散模型重构，实现了在超低比特率下比传统方法高出2-10倍的感知质量。
AI.motivation: 传统视频编解码器在超低比特率下由于过于追求像素保真度，导致视觉质量严重下降，无法满足人类感知需求。
AI.method: 提出了DiSCo框架，将视频分解为文本描述、降质视频以及草图/姿态等三个紧凑模态，并利用条件视频扩散模型进行重构；同时引入了时间前向填充、Token交错和模态特定编解码器等技术。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在低比特率下的感知指标表现比基准语义编解码器和传统编解码器提升了2-10倍。
AI.conclusion: DiSCo框架成功利用生成式先验在超低比特率下实现了高质量、时间连贯的视频重构，在感知指标上显著优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 传统的视频编解码器在优化像素保真度时，会在超低比特率下崩溃并产生严重的伪影。这种失效源于像素精度与人类感知之间的根本错位。我们提出了一种名为DiSCo的语义视频压缩框架，它仅传输最有意义的信息，并依赖生成式先验进行细节合成。源视频被分解为三种紧凑模态：文本描述、时空降质视频以及可选的草图或姿态，分别捕捉语义、外观和运动线索。随后，一个条件视频扩散模型从这些紧凑表示中重构出高质量、时间连贯的视频。文中还提出了时间前向填充、Token交错和模态特定编解码器，以改善多模态生成和模态的紧凑性。实验表明，我们的方法在低比特率下的感知指标上比基准语义编解码器和传统编解码器表现优越2-10倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为DiSCo的语义视频压缩框架，通过将视频分解为语义、外观和运动模态进行传输，并利用条件扩散模型结合生成式先验来重构视频，有效解决了超低比特率下视频质量崩溃的问题。
AI.keywords: 视频压缩, 扩散模型, 语义编码, 生成式先验, 低比特率
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入生成式先验来解决传统编解码器在超低比特率下的视觉质量崩溃问题。创新之处在于将视频分解为语义、外观和运动三个维度进行传输，并利用条件扩散模型重构，这为视频压缩领域提供了从“保真度导向”转向“感知导向”的新思路。

title: A Unified Architecture for N-Dimensional Visualization and Simulation: 4D Implementation and Evaluation including Boolean Operations
comments: 18 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables v4: Clarified scope (4D evaluation) and fixed some expression. Under review at IEEE Access
summary: This paper proposes a unified software architecture for visualization and simulation based on a design targeting an N-dimensional space. The contributions of this study are twofold. First, it presents an architectural configuration that integrates multiple processes into a single software architecture: Quickhull-based convex hull mesh generation, Boolean operations, coordinate transformations for high-dimensional exploration (pose transformation and view transformation), and hyperplane slicing for visualization. Second, it defines "Plex" (.plex) as a file format intended for the exchange of N-dimensional mesh data. The proposed approach adopts an approximate implementation that tolerates numerical errors and prioritizes implementation transparency over guarantees of numerical rigor. The experimental results and evaluations presented in this paper are limited to a 4D implementation; no evaluation is conducted for N > 4, and the discussion is restricted to stating that the architecture itself has a dimension-independent structure. This paper also proposes an interaction design for high-dimensional exploration based on FPS navigation. As an input example involving shape changes over time, a non-rigid body simulation based on XPBD (Extended Position Based Dynamics) is integrated into the 4D implementation. Experimental results confirm that the 4D implementation runs on a single PC.
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables v4: Clarified scope (4D evaluation) and fixed some expression. Under review at IEEE Access

AI.title_translation: 一种用于N维可视化与仿真的统一架构：含布尔运算的4D实现与评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用的N维可视化与仿真软件架构，通过4D实例验证了其在处理复杂几何操作和交互式模拟方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 针对目前高维空间数据可视化与仿真中缺乏统一架构的问题，旨在构建一个能够集成多种处理流程并支持N维扩展的通用软件框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的N维软件架构，集成了Quickhull凸包生成、布尔运算、高维坐标转换、超平面切片以及基于FPS导航的交互设计，并整合了基于XPBD的非刚体模拟，同时定义了Plex数据交换格式。
AI.result: 成功实现了4D环境下的可视化与仿真，验证了该架构在单台PC上运行的可行性，并展示了其在处理形状随时间变化的数据（如非刚体模拟）方面的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建并验证了一个能够处理4D数据并具有扩展至N维潜力的统一可视化与仿真架构，为高维数据探索提供了实用的工具和格式标准。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种基于N维空间设计的统一可视化与仿真软件架构。本研究的贡献主要有两点。首先，它提出了一种将多个过程集成到单一软件架构中的配置：基于Quickhull的凸包网格生成、布尔运算、用于高维探索的坐标变换（位姿变换和视图变换）以及用于可视化的超平面切片。其次，它定义了“Plex”(.plex)作为一种旨在交换N维网格数据的文件格式。所提出的方法采用了容忍数值误差的近似实现，并优先考虑实现透明度而非数值严密性的保证。本文提供的实验结果和评估仅限于4D实现；未对N > 4的情况进行评估，讨论仅限于说明架构本身具有维度无关的结构。本文还提出了一种基于FPS导航的高维探索交互设计。作为涉及形状随时间变化的输入示例，基于XPBD（扩展位置基动力学）的非刚体模拟被集成到4D实现中。实验结果证实，该4D实现可以在单台PC上运行。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种适用于N维空间的统一可视化与仿真架构，集成了网格生成、布尔运算及高维探索工具，并定义了用于数据交换的Plex格式。研究通过4D实现验证了架构的可行性与交互设计，证明了其在单机环境下进行复杂高维数据处理的潜力。
AI.keywords: N维可视化, 仿真架构, 4D实现, 布尔运算, Plex文件格式
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种统一的、与维度无关的架构，通过整合多种几何操作和可视化技术，降低了高维数据处理的门槛。其局限性在于主要通过4D案例进行验证，且优先考虑实现透明度而非数学上的严密性，这在对精度要求极高的科学计算领域可能存在挑战。

title: ShelfGaussian: Shelf-Supervised Open-Vocabulary Gaussian-based 3D Scene Understanding
summary: We introduce ShelfGaussian, an open-vocabulary multi-modal Gaussian-based 3D scene understanding framework supervised by off-the-shelf vision foundation models (VFMs). Gaussian-based methods have demonstrated superior performance and computational efficiency across a wide range of scene understanding tasks. However, existing methods either model objects as closed-set semantic Gaussians supervised by annotated 3D labels, neglecting their rendering ability, or learn open-set Gaussian representations via purely 2D self-supervision, leading to degraded geometry and limited to camera-only settings. To fully exploit the potential of Gaussians, we propose a Multi-Modal Gaussian Transformer that enables Gaussians to query features from diverse sensor modalities, and a Shelf-Supervised Learning Paradigm that efficiently optimizes Gaussians with VFM features jointly at 2D image and 3D scene levels. We evaluate ShelfGaussian on various perception and planning tasks. Experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes demonstrate its state-of-the-art zero-shot semantic occupancy prediction performance. ShelfGaussian is further evaluated on an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) to assess its in the-wild performance across diverse urban scenarios. Project website: https://lunarlab-gatech.github.io/ShelfGaussian/.

AI.title_translation: ShelfGaussian：基于架上监督开放词汇高斯泼溅的 3D 场景理解
AI.tldr: ShelfGaussian 结合了高斯泼溅与视觉基础模型，通过多模态 Transformer 实现高效的开放词汇 3D 场景理解，在自动驾驶任务中表现卓越。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 场景理解方法要么受限于闭集标注，要么因纯 2D 自监督导致几何退化，且难以处理多传感器输入，因此需要一种能利用现成基础模型并具备高效渲染能力的开放词汇方法。
AI.method: 提出多模态高斯 Transformer 以查询不同传感器模态的特征，并采用“架上监督学习范式”（Shelf-Supervised Learning Paradigm），在 2D 图像和 3D 场景级别联合优化高斯模型。
AI.result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 数据集上实现了最先进的零样本语义占用预测性能，并在无人地面车辆（UGV）的野外城市场景中验证了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: ShelfGaussian 通过多模态高斯 Transformer 和架上监督学习范式，成功实现了高效、开放词汇的 3D 场景理解，在零样本语义占用预测任务中达到了最先进水平。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了 ShelfGaussian，这是一个由现成视觉基础模型（VFMs）监督的开放词汇、多模态、基于高斯的 3D 场景理解框架。基于高斯的方法在各种场景理解任务中表现出了卓越的性能和计算效率。然而，现有方法要么将对象建模为由标注 3D 标签监督的闭集语义高斯，忽略了它们的渲染能力；要么通过纯 2D 自监督学习开放集高斯表示，导致几何退化并局限于仅相机设置。为了充分挖掘高斯的潜力，我们提出了一个多模态高斯 Transformer，使高斯能够从不同的传感器模态中查询特征；并提出了一种架上监督学习范式，在 2D 图像和 3D 场景级别高效地利用 VFM 特征优化高斯。我们在各种感知和规划任务上评估了 ShelfGaussian。在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上的实验证明了其最先进的零样本语义占用预测性能。ShelfGaussian 还在无人地面车辆（UGV）上进行了评估，以评估其在不同城市场景中的野外性能。
AI.summary: ShelfGaussian 是一种基于高斯泼溅的 3D 场景理解框架，利用现成的视觉基础模型进行监督。通过多模态高斯 Transformer 融合多传感器特征，并结合 2D/3D 联合优化范式，实现了高效、高质量的开放词汇场景理解。
AI.keywords: 3D 场景理解, 高斯泼溅, 视觉基础模型, 多模态 Transformer, 开放词汇
AI.comments: ShelfGaussian 的创新之处在于将 3D 高斯泼溅与现成的视觉基础模型（VFM）结合，解决了现有方法在闭集限制或纯 2D 自监督导致的几何退化问题。其多模态 Transformer 设计显著提升了跨模态特征查询能力，在自动驾驶场景下的零样本表现优异，具有极高的实用价值。

title: Optical Context Compression Is Just (Bad) Autoencoding
summary: DeepSeek-OCR shows that rendered text can be reconstructed from a small number of vision tokens, sparking excitement about using vision as a compression medium for long textual contexts. But this pipeline requires rendering token embeddings to pixels and compressing from there -- discarding learned representations in favor of an image the vision encoder must then recover from. We ask whether this detour helps. Comparing DeepSeek-OCR's vision encoder against near-zero-parameter mean pooling and a learned hierarchical encoder, we find it does not. For reconstruction, simple direct methods match or surpass vision at every compression ratio. For language modeling, vision performs comparably to truncation -- a baseline that simply discards context -- and loses to the hierarchical encoder at every compression ratio. As expected, all compression methods outperform truncation for factual recall, but vision never surpasses the best direct baseline. The excitement around optical context compression outpaces the evidence. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/ivnle/bad-autoencoding.

AI.title_translation: 光学上下文压缩不过是（糟糕的）自动编码
AI.tldr: 通过实验证明，将文本渲染为图像进行压缩的方法在性能上不仅没有优势，甚至不如简单的直接压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 针对近期将视觉作为长文本上下文压缩媒介的研究（如DeepSeek-OCR），作者怀疑通过将文本渲染为图像再进行压缩的“绕道”方式是否真的有效。
AI.method: 将DeepSeek-OCR的视觉编码器与近零参数的平均池化（mean pooling）以及学习型分层编码器进行对比，并在文本重建、语言建模及事实回忆任务上评估其性能。
AI.result: 在重建任务中，简单直接的方法匹配或超过了视觉压缩；在语言建模任务中，视觉压缩表现仅等同于直接截断，且逊色于分层编码器；在事实回忆任务中，视觉压缩从未超过最优的直接基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 光学上下文压缩（如DeepSeek-OCR）并未提供优于简单直接压缩方法的性能，其作为文本压缩媒介的有效性被高估了。
AI.translation: DeepSeek-OCR表明，渲染后的文本可以从少量的视觉token中重构出来，这激发了人们对使用视觉作为长文本上下文压缩媒介的兴趣。然而，该流程需要将token嵌入渲染为像素并从中进行压缩——这放弃了已学习的表示，转而使用视觉编码器必须从图像中恢复的内容。我们询问这种绕道是否有帮助。通过对比DeepSeek-OCR的视觉编码器与近零参数的平均池化及学习型分层编码器，我们发现它并没有。对于重构，简单的直接方法在每个压缩比下都能匹配或超过视觉方法。对于语言建模，视觉方法的表现与直接丢弃上下文的截断基准相当，且在每个压缩比下都输给了分层编码器。正如预期的那样，所有压缩方法在事实回忆方面都优于截断，但视觉方法从未超过最优的直接基准。围绕光学上下文压缩的兴奋超出了证据的支持。代码和检查点可在 https://github.com/ivnle/bad-autoencoding 获取。
AI.summary: 本文分析了将文本渲染为图像并利用视觉编码器进行上下文压缩的方法。通过与简单基准方法的对比实验，作者发现这种光学压缩方式在文本重建、语言建模和事实回忆任务中并未展现出优势，其实质上是一种效率低下的自动编码过程。
AI.keywords: 光学上下文压缩, 视觉编码器, 文本重建, 语言建模, 自动编码
AI.comments: 该论文通过严谨的对比实验，对近期流行的“视觉压缩文本”方法提出了强有力的质疑。研究揭示了所谓的光学上下文压缩本质上是一种效率低下的自动编码过程，其性能往往不如更简单的基准方法，这为大模型上下文处理的研究方向提供了重要的审视视角。

title: ToG-Bench: Task-Oriented Spatio-Temporal Grounding in Egocentric Videos
summary: A core capability towards general embodied intelligence lies in localizing task-relevant objects from an egocentric perspective, formulated as Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG). Despite recent progress, existing STVG studies remain largely confined to object-centric and descriptive instructions, neglecting the task-oriented reasoning that is crucial for embodied agents to accomplish goal-directed interactions. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{ToG-Bench}, the first task-oriented spatio-temporal video grounding benchmark for egocentric videos. ToG-Bench is characterized by three key features: (1) \textbf{Task-oriented Grounding}, which requires identifying and localizing objects based on intended tasks rather than straightforward descriptions; (2) \textbf{Explicit-Implicit Dual Grounding}, where target objects can be either explicitly mentioned or implicitly inferred by contextual reasoning; (3) \textbf{One-to-Many Grounding}, where a single instruction may correspond to multiple objects involved in task execution. Built upon videos sourced from ScanNet, ToG-Bench comprises 100 annotated clips with 2,704 task-oriented grounding instructions, constructed via a semi-automated pipeline that combines foundation model annotation and human refinement. In addition, we introduce a set of task-level evaluation metrics tailored for multi-object and explicit-implicit object grounding, and systematically benchmark seven state-of-the-art MLLMs. Extensive experiments reveal the intrinsic challenges of task-oriented STVG and substantial performance gaps across explicit-implicit and multi-object grounding, highlighting the difficulty of bridging perception and interaction in embodied scenarios. Data and code will be released at: \href{https://github.com/qaxuDev/ToG-Bench}{https://github.com/qaxuDev/ToG-Bench}..

title: MPCFormer: A physics-informed data-driven approach for explainable socially-aware autonomous driving
summary: Autonomous Driving (AD) vehicles still struggle to exhibit human-like behavior in highly dynamic and interactive traffic scenarios. The key challenge lies in AD's limited ability to interact with surrounding vehicles, largely due to a lack of understanding the underlying mechanisms of social interaction. To address this issue, we introduce MPCFormer, an explainable socially-aware autonomous driving approach with physics-informed and data-driven coupled social interaction dynamics. In this model, the dynamics are formulated into a discrete space-state representation, which embeds physics priors to enhance modeling explainability. The dynamics coefficients are learned from naturalistic driving data via a Transformer-based encoder-decoder architecture. To the best of our knowledge, MPCFormer is the first approach to explicitly model the dynamics of multi-vehicle social interactions. The learned social interaction dynamics enable the planner to generate manifold, human-like behaviors when interacting with surrounding traffic. By leveraging the MPC framework, the approach mitigates the potential safety risks typically associated with purely learning-based methods. Open-looped evaluation on NGSIM dataset demonstrates that MPCFormer achieves superior social interaction awareness, yielding the lowest trajectory prediction errors compared with other state-of-the-art approaches. The prediction achieves an ADE as low as 0.86 m over a long prediction horizon of 5 seconds. Close-looped experiments in highly intense interaction scenarios, where consecutive lane changes are required to exit an off-ramp, further validate the effectiveness of MPCFormer. Results show that MPCFormer achieves the highest planning success rate of 94.67%, improves driving efficiency by 15.75%, and reduces the collision rate from 21.25% to 0.5%, outperforming a frontier Reinforcement Learning (RL) based planner.

title: Temporal Reach-Avoid-Stay Control for Differential Drive Systems via Spatiotemporal Tubes
summary: This paper presents a computationally lightweight and robust control framework for differential-drive mobile robots with dynamic uncertainties and external disturbances, guaranteeing the satisfaction of Temporal Reach-Avoid-Stay (T-RAS) specifications. The approach employs circular spatiotemporal tubes (STTs), characterized by smoothly time-varying center and radius, to define dynamic safe corridors that guide the robot from the start region to the goal while avoiding obstacles. In particular, we first develop a sampling-based synthesis algorithm to construct a feasible STT that satisfies the prescribed timing and safety constraints with formal guarantees. To ensure that the robot remains confined within this tube, we then analytically design a closed-form control that is computationally efficient and robust to disturbances. The proposed framework is validated through simulation studies on a differential-drive robot and benchmarked against state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating superior robustness, accuracy, and computational efficiency.

title: Mitigating Structural Overfitting: A Distribution-Aware Rectification Framework for Missing Feature Imputation
summary: Incomplete node features are ubiquitous in real-world scenarios such as user profiling and cold-start recommendation, which severely hinders the practical deployment of graph learning systems (e.g., GNNs). Existing solutions typically rely on diffusion-based structural smoothing (e.g., feature propagation) to impute missing values. However, we find that these approaches suffer from structural overfitting, leading to three progressive challenges: 1) performance degradation on disjoint graphs, 2) loss of semantic diversity due to over-smoothing, and 3) feature distribution shift when generalizing to unseen graph structures (inductive tasks). To address these challenges, we introduce the \textbf{\DART} framework. It begins by employing {\em Global Structural Augmentation (GSA)}, which establishes global correlations to bridge disjoint components and extend diffusion coverage. Building upon this, we design a semantic rectifier based on masked autoencoding. This module learns the latent feature manifold to recover natural semantic details. Crucially, we introduce a test-time distribution rectification mechanism that projects structurally biased features back onto the learned manifold during inference, effectively bridging the inductive distribution gap. Furthermore, considering that synthetic masking fails to reflect real-world sparsity, we present a new dataset \textbf{Sailing} collected from voyage records with naturally missing attributes. Extensive experiments on six public datasets and Sailing demonstrate that \DART significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both transductive and inductive settings. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/yfsong00/DART.

title: MedGRPO: Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Medical Video Understanding
summary: Large vision-language models struggle with medical video understanding, where spatial precision, temporal reasoning, and clinical semantics are critical. To address this, we first introduce \textbf{MedVidBench}, a large-scale benchmark of 531,850 video-instruction pairs across 8 medical sources spanning video, segment, and frame-level tasks, curated through a rigorous quality assurance pipeline with expert-guided prompting and dual-model validation. While supervised fine-tuning on MedVidBench yields noticeable gains, standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) fails due to imbalanced reward scales across datasets, which destabilizes optimization and leads to training collapse. To overcome this, we introduce \textbf{MedGRPO}, a novel RL framework for balanced multi-dataset training with two key innovations: (1) \emph{cross-dataset reward normalization} that maps each dataset's median performance to a common reward value, ensuring fair optimization regardless of difficulty, and (2) a \emph{medical LLM judge} that evaluates caption quality on five clinical dimensions through comparative similarity scoring. Supervised fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B on MedVidBench outperforms GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5-Flash across all tasks, while MedGRPO further improves the SFT baseline on grounding and captioning. Our work establishes a foundational benchmark and training methodology for advancing medical video understanding with VLMs. Our project website is available at: https://uiiamerica.github.io/medgrpo/.

title: Accurate Models of NVIDIA Tensor Cores
summary: Matrix multiplication is a fundamental operation in both training of neural networks and inference. To accelerate matrix multiplication, Graphical Processing Units (GPUs) provide it implemented in hardware. Due to the increased throughput over the software-based matrix multiplication, the multipliers are increasingly used outside of AI, to accelerate various applications in scientific computing. However, matrix multipliers targeted at AI are at present not compliant with IEEE 754 floating-point arithmetic behaviour, with different vendors offering different numerical features. This leads to non-reproducible results across different generations of GPU architectures, at the matrix multiply-accumulate instruction level. To study numerical characteristics of matrix multipliers -- such as rounding behaviour, accumulator width, normalization points, extra carry bits, and others -- test vectors are typically constructed. Yet, these vectors may or may not distinguish between different hardware models, and due to limited hardware availability, their reliability across many different platforms remains largely untested. We present software models for emulating the inner product behaviour of low- and mixed-precision matrix multipliers in the V100, A100, H100 and B200 data center GPUs in most supported input formats of interest to mixed-precision algorithm developers: 8-, 16-, and 19-bit floating point.

title: VideoCoF: Unified Video Editing with Temporal Reasoner
comments: Accepted by CVPR 2026, Project Page: https://videocof.github.io/
summary: Existing video editing methods face a critical trade-off: expert models offer precision but rely on task-specific priors like masks, hindering unification; conversely, unified temporal in-context learning models are mask-free but lack explicit spatial cues, leading to weak instruction-to-region mapping and imprecise localization. To resolve this conflict, we propose VideoCoF, a novel Chain-of-Frames approach inspired by Chain-of-Thought reasoning. VideoCoF enforces a ``see, reason, then edit" procedure by compelling the video diffusion model to first predict reasoning tokens (edit-region latents) before generating the target video tokens. This explicit reasoning step removes the need for user-provided masks while achieving precise instruction-to-region alignment and fine-grained video editing. Furthermore, we introduce a RoPE alignment strategy that leverages these reasoning tokens to ensure motion alignment and enable length extrapolation beyond the training duration. We demonstrate that with a minimal data cost of only 50k video pairs, VideoCoF achieves state-of-the-art performance on VideoCoF-Bench, validating the efficiency and effectiveness of our approach. Our code, weight, data are available at https://github.com/knightyxp/VideoCoF.
