title: A Simple Method to Enhance Pre-trained Language Models with Speech Tokens for Classification
summary: This paper presents a simple method that allows to easily enhance textual pre-trained large language models with speech information, when fine-tuned for a specific classification task. A classical issue with the fusion of many embeddings from audio with text is the large length of the audio sequence compared to the text one. Our method benefits from an existing speech tokenizer trained for Audio Speech Recognition that output long sequences of tokens from a large vocabulary, making it difficult to integrate it at low cost in a large language model. By applying a simple lasso-based feature selection on multimodal Bag-of-Words representation, we retain only the most important audio tokens for the task, and adapt the language model to them with a self-supervised language modeling objective, before fine-tuning it on the downstream task. We show this helps to improve the performances compared to an unimodal model, to a bigger SpeechLM or to integrating audio via a learned representation. We demonstrate its effectiveness on Argumentative Fallacy Detection and Classification tasks where audio was previously believed counterproductive, and affective computing tasks on a widely-used dataset. We also provide an in-depth analysis of the method, showing that even a random audio token selection helps enhancing the unimodal model. Our code is available [online](https://github.com/salocinc/EACL26SpeechTokFallacy/).

AI.title_translation: 一种用语音标记增强预训练语言模型进行分类的简单方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单方法，通过选择性地整合语音标记来增强文本预训练语言模型在分类任务中的性能，解决了长语音序列的融合难题。
AI.motivation: 将音频与文本嵌入融合时，音频序列长度过大是一个经典问题。现有的语音分词器输出的语音标记序列长且词汇量大，难以低成本地集成到大型语言模型中。此外，在某些任务中，音频信息曾被认为会产生反作用。
AI.method: 该方法利用现有为语音识别训练的语音分词器。通过在多模态词袋表示上应用基于Lasso的特征选择，仅保留任务最重要的音频标记。然后，通过自监督语言建模目标使语言模型适应这些标记，最后在下游任务上进行微调。研究还表明，即使随机选择音频标记也有助于增强单模态模型。
AI.result: 该方法在性能上优于单模态模型、更大的SpeechLM或通过学习表示集成音频的方法。它在论证谬误检测与分类任务（音频此前被认为会产生反作用）和情感计算任务上都表现出有效性。深入分析表明，即使随机选择音频标记也有助于增强单模态模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种简单有效的方法，通过选择性地集成语音标记来增强预训练语言模型在分类任务中的性能。该方法在多个任务中均显示出优越性，甚至在音频此前被认为无益的场景下也带来了改进。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种简单方法，可以轻松地在针对特定分类任务进行微调时，用语音信息增强文本预训练大型语言模型。音频中许多嵌入与文本融合的一个经典问题是音频序列的长度远大于文本序列。我们的方法得益于一个现有的为语音识别训练的语音分词器，该分词器从一个大词汇表中输出长序列的标记，这使得将其低成本地集成到大型语言模型中变得困难。通过在多模态词袋表示上应用简单的基于Lasso的特征选择，我们只保留了任务中最重要的音频标记，并用自监督语言建模目标使语言模型适应它们，然后才在下游任务上进行微调。我们表明这有助于提高性能，相比于单模态模型、更大的SpeechLM或通过学习表示集成音频的方法。我们证明了其在论证谬误检测与分类任务（音频此前被认为会产生反作用）和广泛使用的数据集上的情感计算任务中的有效性。我们还对该方法进行了深入分析，表明即使随机选择音频标记也有助于增强单模态模型。我们的代码已在线提供。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种简单有效的多模态融合方法，旨在通过选择性地集成语音标记来增强文本预训练语言模型在分类任务中的表现。针对现有语音分词器输出长序列语音标记难以集成的问题，该方法利用Lasso特征选择从多模态词袋表示中筛选出关键语音标记，并通过自监督语言建模目标使语言模型适应这些标记，最终在下游任务上进行微调。实验证明，该方法在论证谬误检测和情感计算等任务上均优于多种基线模型，并且即使随机选择语音标记也能带来性能提升。
AI.keywords: 预训练语言模型, 语音标记, 分类, 多模态, 特征选择
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种简单而有效的特征选择方法（基于Lasso），以解决语音和文本模态融合时语音序列过长的问题。其重要性体现在能够在音频信息曾被认为无益的任务中实现性能提升，并且发现即使随机选择音频标记也有助于模型增强，这为未来的多模态研究提供了有趣的见解和潜在的简化方向。

title: ContextDrag: Precise Drag-Based Image Editing via Context-Preserving Token Injection and Position-Aligned Attention
summary: Drag-based image editing enables intuitive visual manipulation through point-based drag operations. Existing methods mainly rely on diffusion inversion or pixel-space warping with inpainting. However, inversion inherently introduces approximation errors that degrade texture fidelity, whereas rigid pixel-space operations discard semantic context and produce unnatural deformations. To address these issues, we introduce ContextDrag, to our knowledge the first framework that brings drag-based manipulation into the in-context image editing paradigm. By leveraging the in-context capabilities of editing models (e.g., FLUX-Kontext), ContextDrag enables precise drag editing without inversion or fine-tuning. Specifically, we first propose Context-preserving Token Injection (CTI), which injects VAE-encoded reference features into attention layers at spatially aligned target positions, guided by latent-space correspondences estimated directly from user-specified control points. By operating on clean, directly encoded features rather than noisy inversion outputs, CTI preserves rich texture details and enables precise drag control. Second, we propose Position-Aligned Attention (PAA) to eliminate interference caused by spatial displacement of reference features. PAA re-encodes positional embeddings of displaced reference tokens to match their target locations, and masks overlapping regions between source and destination to prevent conflicting features from degrading visual consistency. Experiments on DragBench-SR and DragBench-DR demonstrate that ContextDrag achieves SOTA editing accuracy and overall quality, and comprehensive ablations validate the effectiveness of each proposed component. Code will be publicly available.

AI.title_translation: ContextDrag：通过上下文保留令牌注入和位置对齐注意力实现精确的拖拽式图像编辑
AI.tldr: ContextDrag通过上下文保留令牌注入和位置对齐注意力，在不进行反演或微调的情况下，实现了精确的拖拽式图像编辑，解决了现有方法的纹理退化和不自然变形问题。
AI.motivation: 现有拖拽式图像编辑方法主要依赖扩散反演或像素空间扭曲与修复，但反演引入近似误差导致纹理保真度下降，像素空间操作则丢弃语义上下文并产生不自然的变形。
AI.method: ContextDrag是首个将拖拽式操作引入上下文图像编辑范式的框架，利用编辑模型的上下文能力，无需反演或微调。它包含两个核心组件：1. 上下文保留令牌注入（CTI），通过将VAE编码的参考特征注入到注意力层中，并由潜在空间对应关系引导到目标位置，从而保留纹理细节并实现精确控制。2. 位置对齐注意力（PAA），通过重新编码位移参考令牌的位置嵌入以匹配目标位置，并遮蔽源和目标之间的重叠区域，以消除空间位移引起的干扰。
AI.result: 在DragBench-SR和DragBench-DR上的实验表明，ContextDrag实现了SOTA的编辑精度和整体质量，并通过全面的消融实验验证了每个组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ContextDrag通过引入上下文保留令牌注入和位置对齐注意力，成功解决了现有拖拽式图像编辑方法的局限性，实现了高精度和高质量的图像编辑，无需反演或微调。
AI.translation: 拖拽式图像编辑通过基于点的拖拽操作实现直观的视觉操纵。现有方法主要依赖扩散反演或像素空间扭曲与修复。然而，反演固有地引入近似误差，降低了纹理保真度，而刚性像素空间操作则丢弃语义上下文并产生不自然的变形。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了ContextDrag，据我们所知，这是第一个将拖拽式操纵引入上下文图像编辑范式的框架。通过利用编辑模型（例如FLUX-Kontext）的上下文能力，ContextDrag无需反演或微调即可实现精确的拖拽编辑。具体来说，我们首先提出了上下文保留令牌注入（CTI），它将VAE编码的参考特征注入到注意力层中，在潜在空间对应关系（直接从用户指定的控制点估计）的指导下，注入到空间对齐的目标位置。通过对干净、直接编码的特征而非噪声反演输出进行操作，CTI保留了丰富的纹理细节并实现了精确的拖拽控制。其次，我们提出了位置对齐注意力（PAA）来消除由参考特征空间位移引起的干扰。PAA重新编码位移参考令牌的位置嵌入以匹配其目标位置，并遮蔽源和目标之间的重叠区域以防止冲突特征降低视觉一致性。在DragBench-SR和DragBench-DR上的实验表明，ContextDrag实现了SOTA的编辑精度和整体质量，全面的消融实验验证了每个提出的组件的有效性。代码将公开发布。
AI.summary: 本论文介绍了ContextDrag，一个新颖的拖拽式图像编辑框架，旨在解决现有方法中因扩散反演导致的纹理退化和像素空间操作引起的不自然变形问题。ContextDrag是首个将拖拽编辑融入上下文图像编辑范式的系统，它利用编辑模型的上下文能力，无需反演或微调即可实现精确编辑。核心创新包括上下文保留令牌注入（CTI），通过将VAE编码的参考特征精确注入到注意力层中，保留纹理细节；以及位置对齐注意力（PAA），通过重新编码位置嵌入并遮蔽重叠区域，消除空间位移干扰。实验证明ContextDrag在编辑精度和质量上达到了SOTA水平。
AI.keywords: 拖拽式图像编辑, 上下文编辑, 令牌注入, 注意力机制, 图像操纵
AI.comments: ContextDrag的创新之处在于将拖拽式编辑与in-context图像编辑范式相结合，避免了传统扩散反演和像素空间操作的局限性。CTI和PAA是其核心贡献，特别是在纹理保真度和语义一致性方面的提升，为精确且自然的图像编辑提供了新的思路。该方法无需反演和微调，提高了实用性。

title: VABench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in video generation have been remarkable, enabling models to produce visually compelling videos with synchronized audio. While existing video generation benchmarks provide comprehensive metrics for visual quality, they lack convincing evaluations for audio-video generation, especially for models aiming to generate synchronized audio-video outputs. To address this gap, we introduce VABench, a comprehensive and multi-dimensional benchmark framework designed to systematically evaluate the capabilities of synchronous audio-video generation. VABench encompasses three primary task types: text-to-audio-video (T2AV), image-to-audio-video (I2AV), and stereo audio-video generation. It further establishes two major evaluation modules covering 15 dimensions. These dimensions specifically assess pairwise similarities (text-video, text-audio, video-audio), audio-video synchronization, lip-speech consistency, and carefully curated audio and video question-answering (QA) pairs, among others. Furthermore, VABench covers seven major content categories: animals, human sounds, music, environmental sounds, synchronous physical sounds, complex scenes, and virtual worlds. We provide a systematic analysis and visualization of the evaluation results, aiming to establish a new standard for assessing video generation models with synchronous audio capabilities and to promote the comprehensive advancement of the field.

AI.title_translation: VABench：一个全面的音视频生成基准
AI.tldr: 引入VABench，一个全面的基准，用于系统评估和标准化同步音视频生成模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准在视觉质量评估方面表现全面，但在音视频生成，特别是同步音视频输出模型的评估方面缺乏说服力。
AI.method: 本文引入了VABench，一个综合性、多维度的基准框架，旨在系统评估同步音视频生成能力。VABench包含文本到音视频（T2AV）、图像到音视频（I2AV）和立体声音视频生成三种主要任务类型，并建立了涵盖15个维度的两个主要评估模块，这些维度包括成对相似性（文本-视频、文本-音频、视频-音频）、音视频同步、唇语一致性以及音频和视频问答对等。此外，VABench覆盖七个主要内容类别。
AI.result: VABench提供了评估结果的系统分析和可视化。
AI.conclusion: VABench旨在为评估具有同步音频能力的视频生成模型建立新标准，并促进该领域的全面发展。
AI.translation: 最近视频生成领域的进展显著，模型能够生成视觉上引人注目并带有同步音频的视频。然而，尽管现有的视频生成基准为视觉质量提供了全面的指标，但它们在音视频生成方面，尤其是针对旨在生成同步音视频输出的模型，缺乏令人信服的评估。为了弥补这一空白，我们引入了VABench，一个全面且多维度的基准框架，旨在系统评估同步音视频生成的能力。VABench包含三种主要任务类型：文本到音视频（T2AV）、图像到音视频（I2AV）和立体声音视频生成。它进一步建立了两个主要评估模块，涵盖15个维度。这些维度专门评估成对相似性（文本-视频、文本-音频、视频-音频）、音视频同步、唇语一致性以及精心策划的音频和视频问答（QA）对等。此外，VABench涵盖七个主要内容类别：动物、人类声音、音乐、环境声音、同步物理声音、复杂场景和虚拟世界。我们提供了评估结果的系统分析和可视化，旨在为评估具有同步音频能力的视频生成模型建立新标准，并促进该领域的全面发展。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了VABench，一个针对同步音视频生成模型的综合性多维度评估基准。它旨在解决现有基准在评估音视频同步方面的不足，涵盖文本到音视频、图像到音视频及立体声音视频生成任务，并提供15个评估维度和七大内容类别，以期建立新的评估标准并推动领域发展。
AI.keywords: 音视频生成, 基准, 同步, 评估, VABench
AI.comments: VABench的创新在于其全面性和多维度评估方法，特别关注了音视频同步、唇语一致性和跨模态相似性等关键指标，填补了现有视频生成基准在音视频同步评估方面的空白，对促进高质量音视频生成模型的发展具有重要意义。

title: Passing the Baton: High Throughput Distributed Disk-Based Vector Search with BatANN
summary: Vector search underpins modern information-retrieval systems, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and search engines over unstructured text and images. As datasets scale to billions of vectors, disk-based vector search has emerged as a practical solution. However, looking to the future, we must anticipate datasets too large for any single server and throughput demands that exceed the limits of locally attached SSDs. We present BatANN, a distributed disk-based approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) system that retains the logarithmic search efficiency of a single global graph while achieving near-linear throughput scaling in the number of servers. Our core innovation is that when accessing a neighborhood which is stored on another machine, we send the full state of the query to the other machine to continue executing there for improved locality. On 1B-point datasets at 0.95 recall using 10 servers, BatANN achieves 3.5-5.59x of the scatter-gather baseline and 1.44-2.09x the throughput of DistributedANN, respectively, while maintaining mean latency below 3 ms. Moreover, we get these results on standard TCP. To our knowledge, BatANN is the first open-source distributed disk-based vector search system to operate over a single global graph.

AI.title_translation: 传递接力棒：使用BatANN实现高吞吐量分布式磁盘向量搜索
AI.tldr: BatANN通过将查询状态“接力”到数据所在节点，实现了在超大规模数据集上比现有方案更高吞吐量且低延迟的分布式向量搜索。
AI.motivation: 随着数据集规模达到十亿级，单一服务器的内存和SSD吞吐能力已无法满足需求。现有分布式方案在跨节点搜索时的效率和可扩展性存在瓶颈，需要一种能保持全局搜索效率并实现近线性吞吐量扩展的系统。
AI.method: 提出了一种分布式磁盘ANN系统，其核心创新在于当访问存储在其他机器上的邻居节点时，不是简单地获取数据，而是将完整的查询状态发送到该机器，由目标机器接力完成后续搜索，从而显著提高了局部性并减少了网络交互。
AI.result: 在10亿级数据集、0.95召回率的条件下，使用10台服务器时，BatANN的吞吐量是Scatter-Gather基线的3.5-5.59倍，是DistributedANN的1.44-2.09倍，且平均延迟保持在3ms以下。
AI.conclusion: BatANN成功构建了一个高效、可扩展的分布式磁盘向量搜索系统，证明了在保持全局图结构的同时实现近线性吞吐量扩展是可行的，为超大规模向量数据的检索提供了高性能的开源解决方案。
AI.translation: 向量搜索是现代信息检索系统（包括检索增强生成（RAG）管道以及针对非结构化文本和图像的搜索引擎）的基础。随着数据集扩展到十亿级向量，基于磁盘的向量搜索已成为一种实用的解决方案。然而，展望未来，我们必须预见到数据集将超出单台服务器的承载能力，且吞吐量需求将超过本地连接SSD的极限。我们提出了BatANN，这是一个分布式、基于磁盘的近似近邻（ANN）系统，它保留了单一全局图的对数级搜索效率，同时实现了服务器数量近线性的吞吐量扩展。我们的核心创新在于，当访问存储在另一台机器上的邻居时，我们将查询的完整状态发送到该机器，以便在那里继续执行，从而提高了局部性。在10台服务器上使用10亿点数据集且召回率为0.95的情况下，BatANN的吞吐量分别达到Scatter-Gather基线的3.5-5.59倍和DistributedANN的1.44-2.09倍，同时保持平均延迟低于3毫秒。此外，我们是在标准TCP上获得这些结果的。据我们所知，BatANN是第一个在单一全局图上运行的开源分布式磁盘向量搜索系统。
AI.summary: BatANN是一个分布式、基于磁盘的近似近邻搜索系统，旨在处理超大规模数据集。通过创新的查询状态迁移机制，它在维持全局图搜索效率的同时，实现了近线性的吞吐量扩展，显著提升了分布式向量检索的性能。
AI.keywords: 分布式向量搜索, 磁盘存储, 近邻搜索, 高吞吐量, 检索增强生成
AI.comments: BatANN通过引入“传递接力棒”（passing the baton）的分布式执行策略，巧妙地解决了大规模向量搜索中跨节点数据访问的延迟瓶颈，不仅在性能上超越了现有的Scatter-Gather基线和DistributedANN，还保持了全局图结构的搜索效率。其创新点在于将查询状态迁移至数据所在节点，而非仅仅传输数据，这是分布式系统设计中的一个重要优化方向。

title: Personalized Federated Distillation Assisted Vehicle Edge Caching Strategy
comments: This paper has been accepted by IEEE International Conference on Radio Frequency and Antenna Technologies. The source code has been released at: https://github.com/qiongwu86/Federated-Distillation-Assisted-Vehicle-Edge-Caching-Scheme-Based-on-Lightweight-DDPM
summary: Vehicle edge caching is a promising technology that can significantly reduce the latency for vehicle users (VUs) to access content by pre-caching user-interested content at edge nodes. It is crucial to accurately predict the content that VUs are interested in without exposing their privacy. Traditional federated learning (FL) can protect user privacy by sharing models rather than raw data. However, the training of FL requires frequent model transmission, which can result in significant communication overhead. Additionally, vehicles may leave the road side unit (RSU) coverage area before training is completed, leading to training failures. To address these issues, in this paper, we propose a personalized federated distillation assisted vehicle edge caching strategy. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed vehicle edge caching strategy has good robustness to variations in vehicle speed, significantly reducing communication overhead.
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE International Conference on Radio Frequency and Antenna Technologies. The source code has been released at: https://github.com/qiongwu86/Federated-Distillation-Assisted-Vehicle-Edge-Caching-Scheme-Based-on-Lightweight-DDPM

AI.title_translation: 个性化联邦蒸馏辅助车载边缘缓存策略
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种个性化联邦蒸馏辅助车载边缘缓存策略，旨在解决传统联邦学习在车辆边缘缓存中存在的通信开销大和训练失败的问题，同时保护用户隐私。仿真结果表明该策略在车辆速度变化下具有良好的鲁棒性，并显著降低了通信开销。
AI.motivation: 车载边缘缓存技术通过预缓存用户感兴趣的内容来显著减少车辆用户访问内容的延迟。然而，准确预测用户兴趣同时保护隐私是一个关键挑战。传统的联邦学习虽然能保护用户隐私，但存在模型传输频繁导致的通信开销大以及车辆可能在训练完成前离开路边单元（RSU）覆盖区域导致训练失败的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种个性化联邦蒸馏辅助车载边缘缓存策略。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的车载边缘缓存策略对车辆速度的变化具有良好的鲁棒性，并显著降低了通信开销。
AI.conclusion: 个性化联邦蒸馏辅助车载边缘缓存策略能够有效解决传统联邦学习在车辆边缘缓存中面临的通信开销大和训练失败的问题，同时保持隐私保护和对车辆速度变化的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 车载边缘缓存是一种很有前景的技术，可以通过在边缘节点预缓存用户感兴趣的内容，显著降低车辆用户（VUs）访问内容的延迟。在不暴露用户隐私的情况下，准确预测VUs感兴趣的内容至关重要。传统的联邦学习（FL）通过共享模型而非原始数据来保护用户隐私。然而，FL的训练需要频繁的模型传输，这可能导致显著的通信开销。此外，车辆可能会在训练完成前离开路边单元（RSU）的覆盖区域，导致训练失败。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种个性化联邦蒸馏辅助车载边缘缓存策略。仿真结果表明，所提出的车载边缘缓存策略对车辆速度的变化具有良好的鲁棒性，显著降低了通信开销。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种个性化联邦蒸馏辅助车载边缘缓存策略，以解决传统联邦学习在车辆边缘缓存中面临的通信开销大和训练失败的挑战，同时保护用户隐私。该策略旨在通过在边缘节点预缓存用户感兴趣的内容来减少车辆用户访问内容的延迟。仿真结果验证了该策略在车辆速度变化下的鲁棒性，并显著降低了通信开销。
AI.keywords: 车载边缘缓存,联邦学习,联邦蒸馏,通信开销,隐私保护
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入个性化联邦蒸馏来解决车辆边缘缓存中传统联邦学习的痛点，即高通信开销和因车辆移动导致的训练失败。其创新点在于结合了联邦学习的隐私保护优势和蒸馏技术以优化通信效率和鲁棒性。这对于在动态车载环境中实现高效且隐私友好的内容分发具有重要意义。然而，抽象中没有详细说明“个性化联邦蒸馏”的具体机制，未来工作可能需要深入探讨其实施细节和潜在的计算复杂度。

title: Neural Collapse in Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enhances model robustness to out-of-distribution (OOD) data by updating the model online during inference, yet existing methods lack theoretical insights into the fundamental causes of performance degradation under domain shifts. Recently, Neural Collapse (NC) has been proposed as an emergent geometric property of deep neural networks (DNNs), providing valuable insights for TTA. In this work, we extend NC to the sample-wise level and discover a novel phenomenon termed Sample-wise Alignment Collapse (NC3+), demonstrating that a sample's feature embedding, obtained by a trained model, aligns closely with the corresponding classifier weight. Building on NC3+, we identify that the performance degradation stems from sample-wise misalignment in adaptation which exacerbates under larger distribution shifts. This indicates the necessity of realigning the feature embeddings with their corresponding classifier weights. However, the misalignment makes pseudo-labels unreliable under domain shifts. To address this challenge, we propose NCTTA, a novel feature-classifier alignment method with hybrid targets to mitigate the impact of unreliable pseudo-labels, which blends geometric proximity with predictive confidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of NCTTA in enhancing robustness to domain shifts. For example, NCTTA outperforms Tent by 14.52% on ImageNet-C. Project page is publicly available at https://github.com/Cevaaa/NCTTA.

AI.title_translation: 测试时适应中的神经坍缩
AI.tldr: 该研究发现了TTA中的“样本级对齐坍缩”现象，并提出了一种通过混合目标函数实现特征与分类器对齐的新方法NCTTA，显著提升了模型在领域偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时适应（TTA）方法缺乏对领域偏移下性能退化本质原因的理论理解。作者希望通过神经坍缩（NC）理论来揭示并解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为NCTTA的方法，通过混合目标函数（结合几何邻近性和预测置信度）来重新对齐特征嵌入与分类器权重，从而缓解伪标签在领域偏移下的不可靠问题。
AI.result: 实验证明NCTTA有效增强了模型对领域偏移的鲁棒性，在ImageNet-C数据集上比Tent方法提高了14.52%。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过揭示样本级对齐坍缩现象，提出了一种基于特征-分类器对齐的测试时适应新方法NCTTA，有效提升了模型在分布外数据上的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 测试时适应（TTA）通过在推理过程中在线更新模型，增强了模型对分布外（OOD）数据的鲁棒性，但现有方法缺乏对领域偏移下性能退化根本原因的理论洞察。最近，神经坍缩（NC）作为深度神经网络（DNN）的一种涌现几何属性被提出，为TTA提供了有价值的见解。在这项工作中，我们将NC扩展到样本级，并发现了一种称为“样本级对齐坍缩（NC3+）”的新现象，证明了训练模型获得的样本特征嵌入与其对应的分类器权重紧密对齐。基于NC3+，我们发现性能退化源于适应过程中的样本级错位，这种错位在较大的分布偏移下会加剧。这表明有必要将特征嵌入与其对应的分类器权重重新对齐。然而，这种错位使得伪标签在领域偏移下变得不可靠。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了NCTTA，这是一种新颖的特征-分类器对齐方法，采用混合目标来减轻不可靠伪标签的影响，将几何邻近性与预测置信度相结合。大量实验证明了NCTTA在增强领域偏移鲁棒性方面的有效性。例如，NCTTA在ImageNet-C上的表现比Tent高出14.52%。项目页面已在 https://github.com/Cevaaa/NCTTA 公开。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了测试时适应（TTA）中的模型性能退化问题，引入了“样本级对齐坍缩（NC3+）”概念，指出性能下降源于特征嵌入与分类器权重的错位。为此，作者开发了NCTTA方法，通过混合目标函数实现特征与分类器的有效对齐，显著提升了模型在分布外场景下的适应能力。
AI.keywords: 测试时适应, 神经坍缩, 样本级对齐坍缩, 领域偏移, 特征-分类器对齐
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将神经坍缩（NC）理论应用于测试时适应（TTA）领域，通过发现“样本级对齐坍缩（NC3+）”这一新现象，为解决领域偏移下的性能退化问题提供了深刻的几何视角。其提出的NCTTA方法通过混合目标函数有效地缓解了伪标签不可靠的问题，具有较强的理论创新性和实践应用价值。

title: Agile Deliberation: Concept Deliberation for Subjective Visual Classification
summary: From content moderation to content curation, applications requiring vision classifiers for visual concepts are rapidly expanding. Existing human-in-the-loop approaches typically assume users begin with a clear, stable concept understanding to be able to provide high-quality supervision. In reality, users often start with a vague idea and must iteratively refine it through "concept deliberation", a practice we uncovered through structured interviews with content moderation experts. We operationalize the common strategies in deliberation used by real content moderators into a human-in-the-loop framework called "Agile Deliberation" that explicitly supports evolving and subjective concepts. The system supports users in defining the concept for themselves by exposing them to borderline cases. The system does this with two deliberation stages: (1) concept scoping, which decomposes the initial concept into a structured hierarchy of sub-concepts, and (2) concept iteration, which surfaces semantically borderline examples for user reflection and feedback to iteratively align an image classifier with the user's evolving intent. Since concept deliberation is inherently subjective and interactive, we painstakingly evaluate the framework through 18 user sessions, each 1.5h long, rather than standard benchmarking datasets. We find that Agile Deliberation achieves 7.5% higher F1 scores than automated decomposition baselines and more than 3% higher than manual deliberation, while participants reported clearer conceptual understanding and lower cognitive effort.

AI.title_translation: 敏捷审议：主观视觉分类的概念审议
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“敏捷审议”的人机协作框架，旨在通过概念范围界定和概念迭代两个阶段，帮助用户迭代地定义和细化主观视觉分类概念，从而提高分类器性能并降低用户认知负荷。
AI.motivation: 从内容审核到内容策展，需要视觉分类器处理视觉概念的应用正在迅速扩展。现有的人机协作方法通常假设用户在开始时对概念有清晰稳定的理解，以便提供高质量的监督。然而，在现实中，用户常常从模糊的概念开始，需要通过“概念审议”来迭代地细化它们，这是通过对内容审核专家的结构化访谈发现的一种实践。
AI.method: 本文将真实内容审核员在审议中使用的常见策略操作化为一个名为“敏捷审议”的人机协作框架，该框架明确支持演变和主观概念。该系统通过向用户展示边缘案例来帮助他们自行定义概念。系统通过两个审议阶段实现这一点：(1) 概念范围界定，将初始概念分解为结构化的子概念层次结构；(2) 概念迭代，呈现语义上的边缘示例供用户反思和反馈，以迭代地将图像分类器与用户不断演变的意图对齐。该框架通过 18 次用户会话（每次 1.5 小时）进行了评估，而不是标准的基准数据集。
AI.result: 敏捷审议框架比自动化分解基线实现了 7.5% 更高的 F1 分数，比手动审议高出 3% 以上。同时，参与者报告概念理解更清晰，认知努力更低。
AI.conclusion: 敏捷审议框架通过支持用户迭代定义和细化主观视觉概念，显著提高了视觉分类器的性能，并改善了用户体验，尤其在处理模糊和主观概念的视觉分类任务中表现出色。
AI.translation: 从内容审核到内容策展，需要视觉分类器处理视觉概念的应用正在迅速扩展。现有的人机协作方法通常假设用户在开始时对概念有清晰稳定的理解，以便提供高质量的监督。在现实中，用户常常从模糊的概念开始，必须通过“概念审议”来迭代地细化它们，这是我们通过对内容审核专家的结构化访谈发现的一种实践。我们将真实内容审核员在审议中使用的常见策略操作化为一个名为“敏捷审议”的人机协作框架，该框架明确支持演变和主观概念。该系统通过向用户展示边缘案例来帮助他们自行定义概念。系统通过两个审议阶段实现这一点：(1) 概念范围界定，将初始概念分解为结构化的子概念层次结构；(2) 概念迭代，呈现语义上的边缘示例供用户反思和反馈，以迭代地将图像分类器与用户不断演变的意图对齐。由于概念审议本身具有主观性和交互性，我们通过 18 次用户会话（每次 1.5 小时）精心评估了该框架，而不是标准的基准数据集。我们发现，敏捷审议比自动化分解基线实现了 7.5% 更高的 F1 分数，比手动审议高出 3% 以上，同时参与者报告概念理解更清晰，认知努力更低。
AI.summary: 本文提出“敏捷审议”框架，解决主观视觉分类中用户概念模糊不清的问题。该人机协作系统通过将内容审核专家的审议策略操作化，支持概念的演变和主观性。其包含概念范围界定（分解初始概念）和概念迭代（通过边缘案例反馈细化）两个阶段。实验结果表明，敏捷审议比自动化和手动审议基线均能获得更高的 F1 分数，并显著提升用户对概念的理解度和降低认知负荷。
AI.keywords: 敏捷审议, 主观视觉分类, 人机协作, 概念审议, 视觉概念
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它解决了传统人机协作方法中一个被忽视的关键问题：用户在分类初期对概念的理解往往是模糊和不稳定的。通过引入“概念审议”并将其操作化为“敏捷审议”框架，论文提供了一个系统化的方法来处理主观和演变的概念。其评估方式独特，通过长时间的用户会话而非标准数据集来衡量效果，这更符合处理主观任务的实际场景，也凸显了用户体验和认知负荷的重要性。

title: Computational emotion analysis with multimodal LLMs: Current evidence on an emerging methodological opportunity
summary: Research increasingly leverages audio-visual materials to analyze emotions in political communication. Multimodal large language models (mLLMs) promise to enable such analyses through in-context learning. However, we lack systematic evidence on whether current mLLMs can reliably measure emotions in real-world political settings. This paper closes this gap by evaluating open- and closed-weights mLLMs available as of early 2026 in video-based emotional arousal measurement using two complementary human-labeled datasets: speech actor recordings created under laboratory conditions and real-world parliamentary debates. I find a critical lab-vs-field performance gap. In videos created under laboratory conditions, the examined mLLMs arousal scores approach human-level reliability. However, in parliamentary debate recordings, all examined models' arousal scores correlate at best moderately with average human ratings. Moreover, in each dataset, all but one of the examined mLLMs exhibit systematic gender-differential bias, consistently underestimating arousal more for male than for female speakers, resulting in a net-positive intensity bias. These findings reveal important limitations of current mLLMs for real-world political video analysis and establish a rigorous evaluation framework for tracking future developments.

AI.title_translation: 基于多模态大模型的计算情感分析：新兴方法论机遇的现状证据
AI.tldr: 多模态大模型在实验室环境下的情感分析表现尚可，但在真实政治视频中表现受限，并存在明显的性别偏见。
AI.motivation: 虽然多模态大模型在政治沟通情感分析中展现出潜力，但目前缺乏关于其在真实世界政治场景中可靠性的系统性证据。
AI.method: 通过对比两种数据集（实验室录制的演员视频与真实议会辩论视频），评估了截至2026年初多种开放和闭源的多模态大模型在视频情感唤醒度测量中的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现存在显著的“实验室-现实”性能差距：在实验室条件下模型接近人类水平，但在议会辩论中表现仅为中等相关；此外，大多数模型表现出系统性的性别偏见，倾向于低估男性说话者的唤醒度。
AI.conclusion: 当前的多模态大模型在真实政治场景中的情感分析能力有限，且普遍存在性别偏见，在将其应用于实际社会科学研究前需极其谨慎。
AI.translation: 研究日益利用视听材料来分析政治沟通中的情感。多模态大模型（mLLMs）有望通过上下文学习实现此类分析。然而，我们缺乏关于当前多模态大模型能否在真实政治环境中可靠地测量情感的系统性证据。本文通过评估截至2026年初可用的开放和闭源多模态大模型在视频情感唤醒度测量中的表现，填补了这一空白。研究使用了两个互补的人工标注数据集：实验室条件下创建的演讲者录音和真实世界的议会辩论。我发现了严重的实验室与现实场景性能差距。在实验室条件下创建的视频中，所检查的多模态大模型的唤醒度得分接近人类水平的可靠性。然而，在议会辩论录音中，所有检查模型的唤醒度得分与人类平均评分的相关性最多仅为中等。此外，在每个数据集中，除一个模型外，所有检查的多模态大模型都表现出系统性的性别差异偏见，一致地低估男性说话者的唤醒度，从而导致净正强度偏见。这些发现揭示了当前多模态大模型在真实世界政治视频分析中的重要局限性，并为跟踪未来发展建立了一个严格的评估框架。
AI.summary: 本文评估了多模态大模型在视频情感唤醒度测量中的性能，发现其在受控实验室环境下表现良好，但在真实政治辩论中可靠性显著下降，且普遍存在低估男性唤醒度的性别偏见。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 情感分析, 政治沟通, 性别偏见, 模型评估
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了多模态大模型在实验室环境与真实世界政治场景中的性能差异，强调了模型在处理复杂现实数据时的局限性及普遍存在的性别偏见，为未来多模态情感分析的评估提供了重要基准。

title: BLASST: Dynamic BLocked Attention Sparsity via Softmax Thresholding
summary: The growing demand for long-context inference capabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified the computational and memory bottlenecks inherent to the self-attention mechanism. To address this challenge, we introduce BLASST, a drop-in, dynamic sparse attention mechanism that accelerates inference by using only a fixed scalar threshold to skip attention blocks. Our method targets practical inference deployment by removing the barriers to adoption present in existing works. As such, BLASST eliminates training requirements, avoids expensive pre-computation passes, accelerates both prefill and decode across all major attention variants (MHA, GQA, MQA, and MLA), provides optimized support for modern hardware, and easily integrates into existing frameworks. This is achieved by reusing online softmax statistics to identify negligible attention scores, skipping softmax, value block loads, and the subsequent matrix multiplication. We demonstrate the BLASST algorithm by delivering optimized kernels with negligible latency overhead. Our automated threshold calibration procedure reveals a simple inverse relationship between optimal threshold and context length, meaning we require only a single threshold each for prefill and decode per model. Preserving benchmark accuracy, we demonstrate a 1.52x speedup for prefill at 71.9% sparsity and a 1.48x speedup for decode at 73.2% sparsity on modern GPUs.

AI.title_translation: BLASST：通过 Softmax 阈值化实现的动态块注意力稀疏化
AI.tldr: BLASST 是一种无需训练的即插即用型动态稀疏注意力机制，通过跳过不重要的注意力块，在大模型长上下文推理中实现了显著的加速，且对精度影响微乎其微。
AI.motivation: 解决大语言模型在长上下文推理中自注意力机制带来的严重计算和内存瓶颈问题，同时克服现有稀疏注意力方法难以实际部署的局限性。
AI.method: 引入 BLASST 机制，利用在线 Softmax 统计信息识别并跳过不重要的注意力块，通过固定标量阈值实现动态稀疏，并配套高性能内核优化及自动阈值校准流程。
AI.result: 在保持基准测试准确率的前提下，BLASST 在现代 GPU 上实现了 1.52 倍的预填充加速（71.9% 稀疏度）和 1.48 倍的解码加速（73.2% 稀疏度）。
AI.conclusion: BLASST 通过动态块稀疏技术成功缓解了长上下文 LLM 推理中的计算与内存瓶颈，在多种注意力变体上均实现了显著的加速效果，且易于在现有框架中集成。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）对长上下文推理能力需求的增长，自注意力机制固有的计算和内存瓶颈日益凸显。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 BLASST，这是一种即插即用的动态稀疏注意力机制，它仅利用固定的标量阈值来跳过注意力块，从而加速推理。我们的方法旨在满足实际推理部署的需求，消除了现有研究中存在的应用障碍。因此，BLASST 无需训练，避免了昂贵的预计算过程，能够加速所有主流注意力变体（MHA、GQA、MQA 和 MLA）的预填充和解码阶段，为现代硬件提供了优化支持，并能轻松集成到现有框架中。这是通过重用在线 Softmax 统计信息来识别可忽略的注意力分数，进而跳过 Softmax、Value 块加载及后续矩阵乘法来实现的。我们通过提供具有极低延迟开销的优化内核展示了 BLASST 算法。我们的自动阈值校准程序揭示了最优阈值与上下文长度之间简单的反比关系，这意味着每个模型只需为预填充和解码分别设置一个阈值。在保持基准测试准确率的同时，我们在现代 GPU 上实现了 1.52 倍的预填充加速（71.9% 稀疏度）和 1.48 倍的解码加速（73.2% 稀疏度）。
AI.summary: BLASST 是一种无需训练的动态块稀疏注意力机制，通过简单的标量阈值跳过不重要的注意力计算，从而加速 LLM 的长上下文推理。该方法兼容多种注意力架构，易于部署，并能显著提升预填充和解码阶段的推理速度。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 自注意力机制, 推理加速, 块稀疏, Softmax 阈值化
AI.comments: BLASST 的创新之处在于其无需训练、无需预计算且即插即用的特性，极大地降低了在大模型推理中部署稀疏注意力机制的门槛。其通过利用在线 Softmax 统计信息实现动态块稀疏，在保持精度的同时显著提升了推理效率，非常适合工程落地。

title: Finch: Benchmarking Finance & Accounting across Spreadsheet-Centric Enterprise Workflows
summary:
We introduce FinWorkBench (a.k.a. Finch), a benchmark for evaluating agents on real-world, enterprise-grade finance and accounting workflows that interleave data entry, structuring, formatting, web search, cross-file retrieval, calculation, modeling, validation, translation, visualization, and reporting. Finch is built from authentic enterprise workspaces from Enron (15,000 files and 500,000 emails) and other financial institutions spanning 2000 to 2025, preserving the in-the-wild messiness of multimodal artifacts such as tables and charts across diverse domains including budgeting, trading, and asset management.
  We propose a workflow construction process that combines LLM-assisted mining of workflows from authentic enterprise environments with expert annotation. Specifically, we use LLM-assisted, expert-verified derivation of workflows from real-world email threads and spreadsheet version histories, followed by meticulous workflow annotation requiring more than 700 hours of expert effort. This process yields 172 composite workflows with 384 tasks, involving 1,710 spreadsheets with 27 million cells, along with PDFs and other artifacts, capturing the intrinsically messy, long-horizon, knowledge-intensive, and collaborative nature of enterprise work.
  We conduct both human and automated evaluations of frontier AI systems, including GPT 5.1, Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, Grok 4, and Qwen 3 Max. GPT 5.1 Pro spends an average of 16.8 minutes per workflow yet passes only 38.4% of workflows. Comprehensive case studies further highlight the challenges that real-world enterprise workflows pose for AI agents.

AI.title_translation: Finch：跨电子表格中心化企业工作流的金融与会计基准测试
AI.tldr: Finch是一个利用真实企业数据构建的新型金融工作流基准，揭示了当前顶尖AI模型在处理复杂、混乱的会计任务时通过率不足40%，远未达到生产力要求。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI基准测试往往缺乏真实企业环境的复杂性，无法有效评估智能体在处理混乱、多模态、长周期金融与会计工作流时的实际能力。
AI.method: 采用LLM辅助挖掘与专家标注相结合的方法，从真实企业邮件和电子表格版本历史中提取工作流，经过超过700小时的专家人工标注，构建了包含172个复合工作流和384项任务的基准测试集。
AI.result: 在对GPT-5.1、Claude等前沿模型的评估中，表现最好的GPT-5.1 Pro平均每个工作流耗时16.8分钟，但仅能通过38.4%的工作流，显示出当前模型在处理此类任务时表现欠佳。
AI.conclusion: Finch基准测试揭示了当前顶尖AI代理在处理真实、长周期、复杂企业级金融工作流时仍面临巨大挑战，准确率较低，强调了未来在多模态协作与长序列推理方向的研究必要性。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了FinWorkBench（又称Finch），这是一个用于评估智能体在真实、企业级金融和会计工作流中表现的基准测试。这些工作流涵盖了数据录入、结构化、格式化、网络搜索、跨文件检索、计算、建模、验证、翻译、可视化和报告等环节。Finch构建于Enron（1.5万个文件和50万封邮件）及其他金融机构2000年至2025年的真实企业工作空间之上，保留了预算、交易和资产管理等不同领域中表格和图表等多模态数据在现实中的混乱性。我们提出了一种工作流构建流程，结合了LLM辅助的工作流挖掘与专家标注。具体而言，我们利用LLM辅助、专家验证的方式从真实邮件线程和电子表格版本历史中导出工作流，并进行了超过700小时的细致人工标注。该流程产生了172个复合工作流，包含384项任务，涉及1710个电子表格（共2700万个单元格）以及PDF和其他人工制品，捕捉了企业工作中内在的混乱、长周期、知识密集和协作的本质。我们对GPT 5.1、Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.5、Gemini 3 Pro、Grok 4和Qwen 3 Max等前沿AI系统进行了人工和自动化评估。GPT 5.1 Pro平均每个工作流耗时16.8分钟，但仅通过了38.4%的工作流。全面的案例研究进一步突显了真实企业工作流对AI智能体构成的挑战。
AI.summary: Finch（FinWorkBench）是一个基于真实企业数据构建的金融与会计工作流智能体评测基准。通过利用Enron等机构的真实历史文档，该基准模拟了包含数据处理、建模及报告等复杂、长周期的企业任务，为评估前沿AI系统在真实工作场景下的表现提供了权威平台。
AI.keywords: 金融会计, 智能体基准测试, 企业工作流, 多模态数据, 电子表格自动化
AI.comments: 该论文填补了金融与会计领域复杂企业级工作流基准测试的空白。其创新之处在于使用了真实、混乱的企业历史数据（如Enron数据集），而非合成数据，这使得测试结果更具现实意义。局限性在于该基准测试对AI代理的推理和多模态处理能力要求极高，目前顶尖模型表现仍不理想。

title: Two Families of Linear Codes Containing Non-GRS MDS Codes
summary: We construct two new families of linear codes by modifying the generator matrices of generalized Reed-Solomon (GRS) codes. For these codes, we explicitly derive parity-check matrices and establish necessary and sufficient conditions ensuring the MDS property. Additionally, we explore subfamilies within these constructions that are non-GRS MDS codes. We also characterize their self-orthogonal and self-dual properties and present some explicit constructions and examples.

AI.title_translation: 包含非GRS MDS码的两类线性码族
AI.tldr: 通过修改GRS码的生成矩阵，研究者构造了两类包含非GRS MDS码的新型线性码，并给出了其MDS性质及自对偶性的数学刻画。
AI.motivation: 为了构造并识别非GRS MDS码，探索MDS码的更广泛构造形式及其性质。
AI.method: 通过修改广义里德-所罗门（GRS）码的生成矩阵来构造两类新型线性码，并推导其校验矩阵，通过分析参数条件确定其MDS性质。
AI.result: 得到了两类新型线性码，确定了它们成为MDS码的充要条件，并证明了其中存在非GRS MDS码，同时刻画了它们的自正交和自对偶性质。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功构造了两类包含非GRS MDS码的新型线性码，并给出了其满足MDS性质的充要条件及自对偶等性质。
AI.translation: 我们通过修改广义里德-所罗门（GRS）码的生成矩阵，构造了两类新的线性码。对于这些码，我们明确推导了校验矩阵，并建立了确保其满足MDS性质的充要条件。此外，我们探讨了这些构造中属于非GRS MDS码的子族。我们还刻画了它们的自正交和自对偶性质，并给出了一些具体的构造和示例。
AI.summary: 本文通过修改GRS码的生成矩阵，构建了两类新的线性码族，推导了其校验矩阵，明确了其满足MDS性质的条件，并识别出其中的非GRS MDS码，同时分析了其自正交和自对偶特性。
AI.keywords: 线性码, MDS码, 广义里德-所罗门码, 自对偶码
AI.comments: 该研究成功构造了非广义里德-所罗门（Non-GRS）MDS码，这在编码理论中具有重要意义，因为它打破了MDS码即为GRS码的传统认知，为寻找新型MDS码提供了具体的构造方法。

title: Random-Bridges as Stochastic Transports for Generative Models
summary: This paper motivates the use of random-bridges -- stochastic processes conditioned to take target distributions at fixed timepoints -- in the realm of generative modelling. Herein, random-bridges can act as stochastic transports between two probability distributions when appropriately initialized, and can display either Markovian or non-Markovian, and either continuous, discontinuous or hybrid patterns depending on the driving process. We show how one can start from general probabilistic statements and then branch out into specific representations for learning and simulation algorithms in terms of information processing. Our empirical results, built on Gaussian random bridges, produce high-quality samples in significantly fewer steps compared to traditional approaches, while achieving competitive Frechet inception distance scores. Our analysis provides evidence that the proposed framework is computationally cheap and suitable for high-speed generation tasks.

AI.title_translation: 作为生成模型随机传输的随机桥
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用随机桥进行生成建模的方法，通过将生成过程转化为条件随机传输，实现了更少步数的高质量采样。
AI.motivation: 探索生成模型中更高效的随机传输机制，以解决传统生成模型在采样步数和计算效率上的瓶颈。
AI.method: 利用随机桥（条件随机过程）作为连接两个概率分布的随机传输机制，通过高斯随机桥构建学习和模拟算法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在保持具有竞争力的FID分数的同时，显著减少了生成所需的步骤，且计算成本低。
AI.conclusion: 随机桥框架为生成模型提供了一种高效且灵活的随机传输方案，能够以更少的步骤实现高质量采样。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了在生成模型领域使用随机桥（即在固定时间点被条件化以符合目标分布的随机过程）的动机。在此，随机桥在适当初始化时可以充当两个概率分布之间的随机传输，并根据驱动过程表现出马尔可夫或非马尔可夫，以及连续、不连续或混合模式。我们展示了如何从一般的概率陈述出发，推导出用于学习和模拟算法的具体表示。我们的实证结果基于高斯随机桥，与传统方法相比，以显著较少的步骤生成了高质量样本，同时实现了具有竞争力的Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) 分数。我们的分析证明了所提出的框架计算成本低，且适用于高速生成任务。
AI.summary: 本文提出利用随机桥作为生成模型中的随机传输工具。通过将过程条件化以匹配目标分布，该方法能够灵活处理不同的随机模式，并在实验中证明了其在实现高质量、高速生成任务方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 随机桥, 生成模型, 随机传输, 高效采样, 概率分布
AI.comments: 该论文引入了“随机桥（Random-Bridges）”作为生成模型的一种新颖视角，通过利用条件随机过程在固定时间点连接分布。其创新之处在于将生成任务转化为随机传输问题，并展示了在保持高性能（FID分数）的同时，能显著减少生成步数，这在实时生成场景中具有重要价值。

title: GRAFT: Grid-Aware Load Forecasting with Multi-Source Textual Alignment and Fusion
summary: Electric load is simultaneously affected across multiple time scales by exogenous factors such as weather and calendar rhythms, sudden events, and policies. Therefore, this paper proposes GRAFT (GRid-Aware Forecasting with Text), which modifies and improves STanHOP to better support grid-aware forecasting and multi-source textual interventions. Specifically, GRAFT strictly aligns daily-aggregated news, social media, and policy texts with half-hour load, and realizes text-guided fusion to specific time positions via cross-attention during both training and rolling forecasting. In addition, GRAFT provides a plug-and-play external-memory interface to accommodate different information sources in real-world deployment. We construct and release a unified aligned benchmark covering 2019--2021 for five Australian states (half-hour load, daily-aligned weather/calendar variables, and three categories of external texts), and conduct systematic, reproducible evaluations at three scales -- hourly, daily, and monthly -- under a unified protocol for comparison across regions, external sources, and time scales. Experimental results show that GRAFT significantly outperforms strong baselines and reaches or surpasses the state of the art across multiple regions and forecasting horizons. Moreover, the model is robust in event-driven scenarios and enables temporal localization and source-level interpretation of text-to-load effects through attention read-out. We release the benchmark, preprocessing scripts, and forecasting results to facilitate standardized empirical evaluation and reproducibility in power grid load forecasting.

AI.title_translation: GRAFT：结合多源文本对齐与融合的电网感知负荷预测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合多源文本（新闻、社交媒体、政策）的电网负荷预测模型GRAFT，通过交叉注意力实现文本与负荷的精准融合，显著提升了预测性能。
AI.motivation: 电网负荷受天气、日历、突发事件及政策等多种时变外部因素影响，现有的预测方法难以有效整合这些多源异构的文本信息。
AI.method: 改进了STanHOP模型，引入文本对齐机制将每日聚合的文本信息与半小时负荷数据对齐，利用交叉注意力实现文本引导的特征融合，并设计了即插即用的外部存储接口。
AI.result: 在五个澳大利亚州的数据集上，GRAFT在小时、日、月三个尺度上均显著优于现有主流基线模型，且在事件驱动场景下表现出良好的鲁棒性，并具备文本对负荷影响的溯源能力。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT模型通过有效的文本对齐与融合机制，显著提升了多尺度电网负荷预测的准确性与可解释性，为处理外部突发事件对电网的影响提供了有力工具。
AI.translation: 电力负荷同时受到天气、日历节奏、突发事件和政策等外源因素在多个时间尺度上的影响。因此，本文提出了GRAFT（网格感知文本预测），它修改并改进了STanHOP，以更好地支持网格感知预测和多源文本干预。具体而言，GRAFT将每日聚合的新闻、社交媒体和政策文本与半小时负荷严格对齐，并在训练和滚动预测期间通过交叉注意力实现针对特定时间位置的文本引导融合。此外，GRAFT提供了一个即插即用的外部存储接口，以适应实际部署中的不同信息源。我们构建并发布了一个涵盖2019年至2021年五个澳大利亚州的统一对齐基准（包含半小时负荷、每日对齐的天气/日历变量和三类外部文本），并在统一协议下对三个尺度（小时、日、月）进行了系统的、可重复的评估，以便在区域、外部来源和时间尺度之间进行比较。实验结果表明，GRAFT显著优于强基线，并在多个区域和预测范围内达到或超过了现有技术水平。此外，该模型在事件驱动场景中具有鲁棒性，并通过注意力读出实现了文本对负荷影响的时间定位和源级解释。我们发布了基准、预处理脚本和预测结果，以促进电力负荷预测中的标准化实证评估和可重复性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GRAFT模型，旨在解决电网负荷预测中多源文本信息难以有效利用的问题。该方法通过将文本数据与负荷时间序列严格对齐，并利用交叉注意力机制进行特征融合，实现了对负荷预测的文本引导。研究同时发布了涵盖多个维度的统一基准数据集，实验证明该模型在预测精度和可解释性方面均达到领先水平。
AI.keywords: 负荷预测, 多源文本融合, 交叉注意力, 智能电网, 基准数据集
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将多源异构文本信息（新闻、社交媒体、政策）与电网负荷预测相结合，通过交叉注意力机制实现文本对负荷的精准引导。其贡献不仅在于模型本身，还在于构建并开源了高质量的基准数据集，推动了该领域的标准化评估。局限性在于未在文中提及模型在极端计算资源受限环境下的表现。

title: Kinetic-Mamba: Mamba-Assisted Predictions of Stiff Chemical Kinetics
summary: Accurate chemical kinetics modeling is essential for combustion simulations, as it governs the evolution of complex reaction pathways and thermochemical states. In this work, we introduce Kinetic-Mamba, a Mamba-based neural operator framework that integrates the expressive power of neural operators with the efficient temporal modeling capabilities of Mamba architectures. The framework comprises three complementary models: (i) a standalone Mamba model that predicts the time evolution of thermochemical state variables from given initial conditions; (ii) a constrained Mamba model that enforces mass conservation while learning the state dynamics; and (iii) a regime-informed architecture employing two standalone Mamba models to capture dynamics across temperature-dependent regimes. We additionally develop a latent Kinetic-Mamba variant that evolves dynamics in a reduced latent space and reconstructs the full state on the physical manifold. The accuracy and robustness of Kinetic-Mamba was evaluated using both time-decomposition and recursive-prediction strategies. We further assess the extrapolation capabilities of the model on varied out-of-distribution datasets. Computational experiments on Syngas and GRI-Mech 3.0 reaction mechanisms demonstrate that our framework achieves high fidelity in predicting complex kinetic behavior using only the initial conditions of the state variables.

AI.title_translation: Kinetic-Mamba：Mamba辅助的刚性化学动力学预测
AI.tldr: Kinetic-Mamba利用Mamba架构的高效时间建模能力，实现了对复杂、刚性化学动力学系统的高精度、高效预测。
AI.motivation: 精确的化学动力学建模对于燃烧模拟至关重要，但传统的求解方法面临高计算成本和化学系统“刚性”（stiffness）导致的数值稳定性挑战。
AI.method: 提出了四种基于Mamba的变体：(1) 直接预测时间演化的独立Mamba模型；(2) 引入质量守恒约束的Mamba模型；(3) 针对不同温度区间设计的区间感知Mamba模型；(4) 在降维潜空间中进行动力学演化的潜空间Kinetic-Mamba模型。
AI.result: 在Syngas和GRI-Mech 3.0反应机制上的实验表明，该框架仅需初始条件即可高保真地预测复杂的动力学行为，并展现出良好的鲁棒性和外推能力。
AI.conclusion: Kinetic-Mamba框架通过结合神经算子与Mamba架构，能够高效、准确地预测复杂的化学反应动力学行为，为燃烧模拟提供了一种高性能的新工具。
AI.translation: 精确的化学动力学建模对于燃烧模拟至关重要，因为它决定了复杂反应路径和热化学状态的演化。在这项工作中，我们引入了Kinetic-Mamba，这是一个基于Mamba的神经算子框架，它将神经算子的表达能力与Mamba架构的高效时间建模能力相结合。该框架包含三个互补模型：(i) 一个独立Mamba模型，根据给定的初始条件预测热化学状态变量的时间演化；(ii) 一个受约束的Mamba模型，在学习状态动力学的同时强制执行质量守恒；以及(iii) 一个区间感知架构，采用两个独立的Mamba模型来捕捉不同温度依赖区间内的动力学。我们还开发了一种潜在的Kinetic-Mamba变体，它在简化的潜空间中演化动力学，并在物理流形上重建完整状态。我们使用时间分解和递归预测策略评估了Kinetic-Mamba的准确性和鲁棒性。我们进一步评估了该模型在各种分布外数据集上的外推能力。在Syngas和GRI-Mech 3.0反应机制上的计算实验表明，我们的框架仅使用状态变量的初始条件，就能以高保真度预测复杂的动力学行为。
AI.summary: Kinetic-Mamba是一个基于Mamba架构的神经算子框架，旨在解决燃烧模拟中化学动力学的刚性预测问题。该框架通过多种模型变体（包括约束、区间感知和潜空间模型）有效捕捉化学反应的复杂演化，在保持高预测精度的同时提高了计算效率。
AI.keywords: 化学动力学, Mamba架构, 神经网络算子, 燃烧模拟, 刚性系统
AI.comments: 该研究将Mamba架构引入化学动力学模拟，通过创新的架构设计（约束模型、区间模型、潜空间模型）解决了传统动力学模型计算成本高和“刚性”难题，在燃烧模拟领域具有重要的应用潜力。

title: MARC: Multi-Label Adaptive Retrieval Contrastive Loss for Remote Sensing Images
summary: Semantic overlap among land-cover categories, highly imbalanced label distributions, and complex inter-class co-occurrence patterns constitute significant challenges for multi-label remote-sensing image retrieval. In this article, Multi-Label Adaptive Contrastive Learning (MACL) is introduced as an extension of contrastive learning to address them. It integrates label-aware sampling, frequency-sensitive weighting, and dynamic-temperature scaling to achieve balanced representation learning across both common and rare categories. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets (DLRSD, ML-AID, and WHDLD), show that MACL consistently outperforms contrastive-loss based baselines, effectively mitigating semantic imbalance and delivering more reliable retrieval performance in large-scale remote-sensing archives. Code, pretrained models, and evaluation scripts will be released at https://github.com/Amna-128/MARC upon acceptance.

AI.title_translation: MARC：用于遥感图像的多标签自适应检索对比损失
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对遥感图像多标签检索的自适应对比学习框架（MACL），通过采样、加权和温度调节策略解决了数据分布不平衡与语义重叠问题。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中存在严重的语义重叠、标签分布高度不平衡以及复杂的类间共现模式，导致传统检索方法难以获得均衡且准确的表示。
AI.method: 提出了多标签自适应对比学习（MACL）框架，集成了标签感知采样、频率敏感加权以及动态温度缩放技术。
AI.result: 在DLRSD、ML-AID和WHDLD三个基准数据集上的实验表明，MACL在性能上优于基于对比损失的基线方法，有效减轻了语义不平衡问题并提升了大规模检索效果。
AI.conclusion: MACL框架通过多维度的自适应优化策略，有效解决了遥感图像检索中的语义与分布不平衡难题，提升了检索系统的性能。
AI.translation: 土地覆盖类别之间的语义重叠、高度不平衡的标签分布以及复杂的类间共现模式，构成了多标签遥感图像检索的重大挑战。在本文中，我们引入了多标签自适应对比学习（MACL）作为对比学习的扩展来解决这些问题。它集成了标签感知采样、频率敏感加权和动态温度缩放，以实现跨常见和罕见类别的平衡表示学习。在三个基准数据集（DLRSD、ML-AID 和 WHDLD）上的大量实验表明，MACL 始终优于基于对比损失的基线，有效地减轻了语义不平衡，并在大规模遥感档案中提供了更可靠的检索性能。代码、预训练模型和评估脚本将在录用后发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为MACL的新型对比学习框架，专门用于解决多标签遥感图像检索中的不平衡和复杂语义挑战。通过引入标签感知采样、频率敏感加权和动态温度缩放，该方法实现了类别间均衡的特征表示，并在多个基准测试中验证了其优越性。
AI.keywords: 多标签检索, 对比学习, 遥感图像, 样本不平衡, 自适应表示学习
AI.comments: 该论文针对多标签遥感图像检索中的语义重叠、样本不平衡及复杂的类间共现问题，提出了一种创新的对比学习改进方案。其核心优势在于通过自适应机制平衡了常见与罕见类别的表示学习，具有较高的实际应用价值。

title: SFBD-OMNI: Bridge models for lossy measurement restoration with limited clean samples
summary: In many real-world scenarios, obtaining fully observed samples is prohibitively expensive or even infeasible, while partial and noisy observations are comparatively easy to collect. In this work, we study distribution restoration with abundant noisy samples, assuming the corruption process is available as a black-box generator. We show that this task can be framed as a one-sided entropic optimal transport problem and solved via an EM-like algorithm. We further provide a test criterion to determine whether the true underlying distribution is recoverable under per-sample information loss, and show that in otherwise unrecoverable cases, a small number of clean samples can render the distribution largely recoverable. Building on these insights, we introduce SFBD-OMNI, a bridge model-based framework that maps corrupted sample distributions to the ground-truth distribution. Our method generalizes Stochastic Forward-Backward Deconvolution (SFBD; Lu et al., 2025) to handle arbitrary measurement models beyond Gaussian corruption. Experiments across benchmark datasets and diverse measurement settings demonstrate significant improvements in both qualitative and quantitative performance.

AI.title_translation: SFBD-OMNI：用于少量干净样本下有损测量恢复的桥模型
AI.tldr: 提出 SFBD-OMNI 框架，利用少量干净样本和桥模型，将损坏的噪声数据恢复为真实分布，适用于各种复杂的非高斯损坏模型。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中获取完全观测样本昂贵或不可行，而获取部分噪声样本较容易，作者旨在解决在仅有大量噪声样本和少量干净样本情况下，如何从损坏观测中恢复真实数据分布的问题。
AI.method: 将问题建模为单侧熵最优传输问题，通过类似 EM 的算法求解；引入基于桥模型的 SFBD-OMNI 框架，将损坏样本分布映射到真实分布，并扩展了对非高斯损坏的支持。
AI.result: 通过实验证明，该方法在多个基准数据集和不同的测量设置下，在定性和定量性能上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SFBD-OMNI 提供了一种强大的通用框架，通过桥模型和少量干净样本的辅助，能够有效地从各种复杂的损坏观测中恢复出真实分布。
AI.translation: 在许多现实场景中，获取完全观测的样本代价高昂甚至不可行，而获取部分噪声观测则相对容易。在这项工作中，我们研究了在拥有大量噪声样本且损坏过程作为黑盒生成器可用的情况下的分布恢复问题。我们证明了该任务可以被构建为一个单侧熵最优传输问题，并可以通过一种类似 EM 的算法来求解。我们进一步提供了一个测试准则，用以确定在每样本信息丢失的情况下，真实潜在分布是否可恢复；并证明在原本不可恢复的情况下，少量干净样本可以使分布在很大程度上变得可恢复。基于这些见解，我们引入了 SFBD-OMNI，这是一个基于桥模型的框架，将损坏的样本分布映射到真实分布。我们的方法推广了随机前向-后向反卷积（SFBD；Lu 等人，2025），以处理超出高斯损坏范围的任意测量模型。在基准数据集和多种测量设置下的实验证明，该方法在定性和定量性能上均有显著提升。
AI.summary: 针对难以获取完整数据的问题，本文提出了 SFBD-OMNI 框架，利用大量噪声样本和少量干净样本，通过将分布恢复视为熵最优传输问题，实现了对复杂非高斯损坏观测的有效还原。
AI.keywords: 分布恢复, 桥模型, 熵最优传输, 测量恢复, 噪声观测
AI.comments: 该研究通过将分布恢复问题形式化为单侧熵最优传输问题，并结合桥模型框架，有效解决了在仅有少量干净样本且损坏过程为黑盒情况下的数据恢复难题，具有很强的理论深度和实际应用价值。

title: FLEG: Feed-Forward Language Embedded Gaussian Splatting from Any Views via Compact Semantic Representation
summary: We present FLEG, a feed-forward network that reconstructs language-embedded 3D Gaussians from arbitrary views. Previous feed-forward language-embedded Gaussian reconstruction methods are restricted to a fixed number of input views and typically attach a language-aligned semantic embedding to each Gaussian, resulting in impractical input settings and semantic redundancy. In contrast, we introduce a geometry-semantic dual-branch distillation framework that enables flexible input from arbitrary multi-view images without camera parameters. We also propose a novel-view-based distillation strategy during training that mitigates overfitting to input views. In addition, we observe that semantic representations are significantly sparser than geometric ones, and per-Gaussian language embedding is unnecessary. To exploit this sparsity, we design a decoupled language embedding strategy that represents language information with a sparse set of semantic Gaussians, rather than attaching embeddings to every Gaussian. Compared with dense pixel-aligned per-Gaussian embedding schemes, our method uses only 5\% of the language embeddings while maintaining comparable semantic fidelity, effectively reducing storage costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLEG outperforms state-of-the-art feed-forward reconstruction and language-embedded Gaussian methods in both reconstruction quality and language-aligned semantic representation. Project page: https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/fleg.

AI.title_translation: FLEG：通过紧凑语义表示实现任意视角下的前馈语言嵌入高斯泼溅
AI.tldr: FLEG 通过引入稀疏语义高斯和双分支蒸馏，在无需相机参数的情况下实现了高效、低存储成本的语言嵌入 3D 重建。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在输入视角数量上受限，且通常为每个高斯分配语义嵌入，导致输入设置不灵活、语义信息冗余以及存储成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出了一种几何-语义双分支蒸馏框架，支持无相机参数的任意视角输入；采用基于新视角的蒸馏策略以减轻过拟合；设计了“解耦语言嵌入策略”，利用稀疏的语义高斯集来表示语言信息。
AI.result: 在保持语义保真度的同时，仅使用了传统方法 5% 的语言嵌入量；在重建质量和语义对齐表现上均优于现有的前馈重建和语言嵌入式高斯方法。
AI.conclusion: FLEG 通过几何-语义双分支蒸馏框架和解耦语言嵌入策略，实现了高效、高质量的语言嵌入式 3D 高斯重建，在降低存储需求的同时提升了语义表达能力。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 FLEG，这是一个从任意视角重建语言嵌入 3D 高斯的前馈网络。以前的前馈语言嵌入高斯重建方法局限于固定数量的输入视角，并且通常为每个高斯附加一个语言对齐的语义嵌入，导致输入设置不切实际且存在语义冗余。相比之下，我们引入了一种几何-语义双分支蒸馏框架，支持来自任意多视图图像的灵活输入，且无需相机参数。我们还在训练过程中提出了一种基于新视角的蒸馏策略，以减轻对输入视角的过拟合。此外，我们观察到语义表示比几何表示稀疏得多，为每个高斯附加语言嵌入是不必要的。为了利用这种稀疏性，我们设计了一种解耦语言嵌入策略，用一组稀疏的语义高斯来表示语言信息，而不是为每个高斯附加嵌入。与密集的像素对齐每高斯嵌入方案相比，我们的方法仅使用了 5% 的语言嵌入，同时保持了相当的语义保真度，有效降低了存储成本。大量实验表明，FLEG 在重建质量和语言对齐语义表示方面均优于最先进的前馈重建和语言嵌入高斯方法。项目页面：https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/fleg。
AI.summary: FLEG 是一种新型前馈网络，用于从任意视角重建语言嵌入式 3D 高斯。通过几何-语义双分支蒸馏和解耦语义高斯策略，该方法解决了传统方法中输入受限、语义冗余和存储效率低的问题，实现了更高效的 3D 场景语义理解。
AI.keywords: 3D 高斯泼溅, 语言嵌入, 几何-语义蒸馏, 稀疏语义表示, 前馈网络
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“解耦语言嵌入策略”，通过稀疏的语义高斯来表示语义信息，而非传统的每个高斯都绑定嵌入，这显著降低了存储成本。同时，该方法不依赖相机参数且支持任意视角输入，具有很强的实用性。

title: Exploration vs. Fixation: Scaffolding Divergent and Convergent Thinking for Human-AI Co-Creation with Generative Models
summary: Generative AI has democratized content creation, but popular chatbot-based interfaces often prioritize execution, generating fully rendered artifacts right away. This issue can lead to premature convergence and design fixation, where users are being anchored to initial outputs. Recent works have proposed new interfaces to address this issue by supporting exploration, though typically constrained to be semantically close to a user's initial task framing, potentially limiting the creativity of the outcomes. We examine an approach grounded in the Geneplore model of creative cognition and instantiate it in a human-AI co-creation system, HAICo, for creative image generation. HAICo explicitly structures the creative process into two switchable modes: DIVERGENT mode scaffolds the broad exploration of remote conceptual ideas; CONVERGENT mode supports a targeted refinement of selected ideas. Through a within-subjects study (N=24) on a poster image creation task, we demonstrate that HAICo outperforms ChatGPT across multiple dimensions of creativity and usability. Our results highlight the critical need to shift from pure execution-focused chatbots to scaffolded co-creation systems that actively guide exploration and foster the creative process.

AI.title_translation: 探索与固定：为人机共创生成模型构建发散与收敛思维的支架
AI.tldr: 通过在AI创作系统中引入发散与收敛的模式切换，有效克服了生成式AI导致的设计固定问题，提升了人机共创的创造力。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式AI聊天界面倾向于直接生成完整作品，容易导致用户产生“过早收敛”和“设计固定”现象，限制了用户的创造力。
AI.method: 基于Geneplore创造性认知模型开发了HAICo系统，将创作过程显式划分为“发散模式”（探索广泛概念）和“收敛模式”（针对性细化）两种可切换模式，并通过N=24的受试者内研究进行验证。
AI.result: 在海报图像创作任务中，HAICo系统在创造力和可用性的多个维度上均优于ChatGPT。
AI.conclusion: 通过明确区分发散与收敛模式的交互设计，能够有效提升人机协作中的创造性表现，优于传统的直接执行式聊天机器人。
AI.translation: 生成式AI普及了内容创作，但流行的基于聊天机器人的界面往往优先考虑执行，直接生成完整渲染的作品。这个问题可能导致过早收敛和设计固定，即用户被锚定在初始输出上。近期的研究提出了支持探索的新界面，但通常局限于与用户初始任务框架语义接近的范围，这可能限制了结果的创造性。我们研究了一种基于创造性认知Geneplore模型的方法，并将其实例化于一个用于创意图像生成的人机共创系统HAICo中。HAICo将创作过程明确结构化为两种可切换模式：发散模式支持对遥远概念的广泛探索；收敛模式支持对选定想法的针对性细化。通过一项关于海报图像创作任务的受试者内研究（N=24），我们证明了HAICo在创造力和可用性的多个维度上优于ChatGPT。我们的结果强调了从纯粹侧重执行的聊天机器人转向主动引导探索并促进创造过程的支架式共创系统的迫切需求。
AI.summary: 本文针对生成式AI容易导致用户设计固定化的问题，提出了一种基于Geneplore认知模型的HAICo系统。该系统通过将创作过程解构为发散探索和收敛细化两种模式，引导用户进行更深层次的创造，实验证明该方法显著提升了人机共创的质量。
AI.keywords: 人机共创, 生成式模型, 创造性思维, 交互设计, 认知模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入认知科学中的Geneplore模型来解决生成式AI创作中的“过早收敛”和“设计固定”问题，具有很高的学术价值和实践意义。它不仅关注AI的生成能力，更关注如何通过交互设计引导人类的创造性思维过程，是人机协作领域的一个重要方向。

title: SWE-EVO: Benchmarking Coding Agents in Long-Horizon Software Evolution Scenarios
summary: Existing benchmarks for AI coding agents focus on isolated, single-issue tasks such as fixing a bug or adding a small feature. However, real-world software engineering is a long-horizon endeavor: developers interpret high-level requirements, coordinate changes across many files, and evolve codebases over multiple iterations while preserving functionality. We introduce SWE-EVO, a benchmark for this long-horizon software evolution challenge. Constructed from release notes of seven mature open-source Python projects, SWE-EVO comprises 48 tasks requiring multi-step modifications spanning an average of 21 files, validated against test suites averaging 874 tests per instance. Experiments reveal a striking capability gap: GPT-5.4 with OpenHands achieves only 25% on SWE-EVO versus 72.80% achieved by GPT-5.2 on SWE-Bench Verified, showing that current agents struggle with sustained, multi-file reasoning. We also propose Fix Rate, a metric capturing partial progress on these complex, long-horizon tasks.

title: NASTaR: NovaSAR Automated Ship Target Recognition Dataset
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) offers a unique capability for all-weather, space-based maritime activity monitoring by capturing and imaging strong reflections from ships at sea. A well-defined challenge in this domain is ship type classification. Due to the high diversity and complexity of ship types, accurate recognition is difficult and typically requires specialized deep learning models. These models, however, depend on large, high-quality ground-truth datasets to achieve robust performance and generalization. Furthermore, the growing variety of SAR satellites operating at different frequencies and spatial resolutions has amplified the need for more annotated datasets to enhance model accuracy. To address this, we present the NovaSAR Automated Ship Target Recognition (NASTaR) dataset. This dataset comprises of 3415 ship patches extracted from NovaSAR S-band imagery, with labels matched to AIS data. It includes distinctive features such as 23 unique classes, inshore/offshore separation, and an auxiliary wake dataset for patches where ship wakes are visible. We validated the dataset applicability across prominent ship-type classification scenarios using benchmark deep learning models. Results demonstrate over 60% accuracy for classifying four major ship types, over 70% for a three-class scenario, more than 75% for distinguishing cargo from tanker ships, and over 87% for identifying fishing vessels. The NASTaR dataset is available at https://doi.org/10.5523/bris.2tfa6x37oerz2lyiw6hp47058, while relevant codes for benchmarking and analysis are available at https://github.com/benyaminhosseiny/nastar.

title: Restore-R1: Efficient Image Restoration Agents via Reinforcement Learning with Multimodal LLM Perceptual Feedback
summary: Complex image restoration aims to recover high-quality images from inputs affected by multiple degradations such as blur, noise, rain, and compression artifacts. Recent restoration agents, powered by vision-language models and large language models, offer promising restoration capabilities but suffer from significant efficiency bottlenecks due to reflection, rollback, and iterative tool searching. Moreover, their performance heavily depends on degradation recognition models that require extensive annotations for training, limiting their applicability in label-free environments. To address these limitations, we propose a policy optimization-based restoration framework that learns an lightweight agent to determine tool-calling sequences. The agent operates in a sequential decision process, selecting the most appropriate restoration operation at each step to maximize final image quality. To enable training within label-free environments, we introduce a novel reward mechanism driven by multimodal large language models, which act as human-aligned evaluator and provide perceptual feedback for policy improvement. Once trained, our agent executes a deterministic restoration plans without redundant tool invocations, significantly accelerating inference while maintaining high restoration quality. Extensive experiments show that despite using no supervision, our method matches SOTA performance on full-reference metrics and surpasses existing approaches on no-reference metrics across diverse degradation scenarios.

title: VOIC: Visible-Occluded Integrated Guidance for 3D Semantic Scene Completion
summary:
Camera-based 3D Semantic Scene Completion (SSC) is a critical task for autonomous driving and robotic scene understanding. It aims to infer a complete 3D volumetric representation of both semantics and geometry from a single image. Existing methods typically focus on end-to-end 2D-to-3D feature lifting and voxel completion. However, they often overlook the interference between high-confidence visible-region perception and low-confidence occluded-region reasoning caused by single-image input, which can lead to feature dilution and error propagation.
  To address these challenges, we introduce an offline Visible Region Label Extraction (VRLE) strategy that explicitly separates and extracts voxel-level supervision for visible regions from dense 3D ground truth. This strategy purifies the supervisory space for two complementary sub-tasks: visible-region perception and occluded-region reasoning. Building on this idea, we propose the Visible-Occluded Interactive Completion Network (VOIC), a novel dual-decoder framework that explicitly decouples SSC into visible-region semantic perception and occluded-region scene completion. VOIC first constructs a base 3D voxel representation by fusing image features with depth-derived occupancy. The visible decoder focuses on generating high-fidelity geometric and semantic priors, while the occlusion decoder leverages these priors together with cross-modal interaction to perform coherent global scene reasoning.
  Extensive experiments on the SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI360 benchmarks demonstrate that VOIC outperforms existing monocular SSC methods in both geometric completion and semantic segmentation accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

title: Geometric Organization of Cognitive States in Transformer Embedding Spaces
summary: Recent work has shown that transformer-based language models learn rich geometric structure in their embedding spaces. In this work, we investigate whether sentence embeddings exhibit structured geometric organization aligned with human-interpretable cognitive or psychological attributes. We construct a dataset of 480 natural-language sentences annotated with both continuous energy scores (ranging from -5 to +5) and discrete tier labels spanning seven ordered cognitive annotation tiers, intended to capture a graded progression from highly constricted or reactive expressions toward more coherent and integrative cognitive states. Using fixed sentence embeddings from multiple transformer models, we evaluate the recoverability of these annotations via linear and shallow nonlinear probes. Across models, both continuous energy scores and tier labels are reliably decodable, with linear probes already capturing substantial structure. To assess statistical significance, we conduct nonparametric permutation tests that randomize labels, showing that probe performance exceeds chance under both regression and classification null hypotheses. Qualitative analyses using UMAP visualizations and tier-level confusion matrices further reveal a coherent low-to-high gradient and predominantly local (adjacent-tier) confusions. Together, these results indicate that transformer embedding spaces exhibit statistically significant geometric organization aligned with the annotated cognitive structure.

title: FinPercep-RM: A Fine-grained Reward Model and Co-evolutionary Curriculum for RL-based Real-world Super-Resolution
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) has proven effective in image generation field guided by reward models to align human preferences. Motivated by this, adapting RLHF for Image Super-Resolution (ISR) tasks has shown promise in optimizing perceptual quality with Image Quality Assessment (IQA) model as reward models. However, the traditional IQA model usually output a single global score, which are exceptionally insensitive to local and fine-grained distortions. This insensitivity allows ISR models to produce perceptually undesirable artifacts that yield spurious high scores, misaligning optimization objectives with perceptual quality and results in reward hacking. To address this, we propose a Fine-grained Perceptual Reward Model (FinPercep-RM) based on an Encoder-Decoder architecture. While providing a global quality score, it also generates a Perceptual Degradation Map that spatially localizes and quantifies local defects. We specifically introduce the FGR-30k dataset to train this model, consisting of diverse and subtle distortions from real-world super-resolution models. Despite the success of the FinPercep-RM model, its complexity introduces significant challenges in generator policy learning, leading to training instability. To address this, we propose a Co-evolutionary Curriculum Learning (CCL) mechanism, where both the reward model and the ISR model undergo synchronized curricula. The reward model progressively increases in complexity, while the ISR model starts with a simpler global reward for rapid convergence, gradually transitioning to the more complex model outputs. This easy-to-hard strategy enables stable training while suppressing reward hacking. Experiments validates the effectiveness of our method across ISR models in both global quality and local realism on RLHF methods.

title: The N-5 Scaling Law: Topological Dimensionality Reduction in the Optimal Design of Fully-actuated Multirotors
summary: The geometric design of fully-actuated and omnidirectional N-rotor aerial vehicles is conventionally formulated as a parametric optimization problem, seeking a single optimal set of N orientations within a fixed architectural family. This work departs from that paradigm to investigate the intrinsic topological structure of the optimization landscape itself. We formulate the design problem on the product manifold of Projective Lines \RP^2^N, fixing the rotor positions to the vertices of polyhedral chassis while varying their lines of action. By minimizing a coordinate-invariant Log-Volume isotropy metric, we reveal that the topology of the global optima is governed strictly by the symmetry of the chassis. For generic (irregular) vertex arrangements, the solutions appear as a discrete set of isolated points. However, as the chassis geometry approaches regularity, the solution space undergoes a critical phase transition, collapsing onto an N-dimensional Torus of the lines tangent at the vertexes to the circumscribing sphere of the chassis, and subsequently reducing to continuous 1-dimensional curves driven by Affine Phase Locking. We synthesize these observations into the N-5 Scaling Law: an empirical relationship holding for all examined regular planar polygons and Platonic solids (N <= 10), where the space of optimal configurations consists of K=N-5 disconnected 1D topological branches. We demonstrate that these locking patterns correspond to a sequence of admissible Star Polygons {N/q}, allowing for the exact prediction of optimal phases for arbitrary N. Crucially, this topology reveals a design redundancy that enables optimality-preserving morphing: the vehicle can continuously reconfigure along these branches while preserving optimal isotropic control authority.

title: Stream-DiffVSR: Low-Latency Streamable Video Super-Resolution via Auto-Regressive Diffusion
summary: Diffusion-based video super-resolution (VSR) methods deliver strong perceptual quality but are often unsuitable for latency-sensitive scenarios due to reliance on future frames and expensive multi-step denoising. We propose Stream-DiffVSR, a causally conditioned diffusion framework for efficient online VSR. Operating strictly on past frames, Stream-DiffVSR integrates a four-step distilled denoiser for fast inference, an Auto-regressive Temporal Guidance (ARTG) module that injects motion-aligned cues during latent denoising, and a lightweight temporal-aware decoder with a Temporal Processor Module (TPM) to enhance detail and temporal coherence. Unlike chunk-wise streaming inference, our strictly frame-by-frame causal design avoids sequence-level waiting, substantially reducing time-to-first-frame and end-to-end latency. Stream-DiffVSR processes 720p frames in 0.328 seconds on an RTX 4090 and consistently outperforms prior diffusion-based baselines. Compared with the online state-of-the-art TMP, it improves perceptual quality (LPIPS +0.095) while reducing latency by over 130x. Moreover, Stream-DiffVSR substantially lowers time-to-first-frame for diffusion-based VSR, reducing initial delay from over 4600 seconds to 0.328 seconds, making diffusion-based VSR markedly more practical for low-latency online and streaming deployment. Project page: https://jamichss.github.io/stream-diffvsr-project-page/
